title.zh: 艾伯塔省公投：约四分之三选民支持留在加拿大
title.en: Albertans vote by a wide margin to stay in Canada

summary.zh: 艾伯塔省10月19日举行了一场不具约束力的公投，早期、非官方的计票结果显示，约76%的选民支持留在加拿大，约24%支持启动一个可能通向未来分离公投的程序，已统计选票约180万张。总理卡尼称这是一个“明确的团结选择”，省长丹妮尔·史密斯说，看到早期结果显示多数人支持留在加拿大，她“非常高兴”。萨斯喀彻温省省长表示，将与艾伯塔人合作打造一个更强大的国家。这场公投由史密斯在5月宣布，如果通过，将使艾伯塔走上举行未来分离公投的道路。多家媒体指出，这一结果不太可能终结当地的独立运动，目前报道的数字仍是初步结果，尚无最终认证的官方总数。
summary.en: Albertans voted in a non-binding referendum on October 19, and early unofficial results show roughly 76 per cent chose to remain in Canada, while about 24 per cent backed starting a process that could lead to a future vote on separation. About 1.8 million ballots had been counted. Prime Minister Mark Carney called the result a clear choice for unity. Premier Danielle Smith, who announced the referendum in May, said she was very pleased that early results showed widespread support for staying. Saskatchewan's premier said he would work with Albertans to build a stronger country. Approval would have put Alberta on a path toward a later vote on separation. Several outlets noted that the result is unlikely to end the independence movement, and the figures are preliminary, with no final certified totals yet.

title.zh: 卡尼在下议院悼念温赖特基地大火遇难军人
title.en: Carney mourns four soldiers killed in CFB Wainwright fire

summary.zh: 10月17日下午，艾伯塔省温赖特加拿大军事基地的训练区发生大火，4名军人遇难，另有39人受伤，其中至少19人伤势危重。遇难者包括摩根·黄中士，以及列兵肖恩·法雷尔、艾登·古尔丁和海登·莱克马克，他们都属于第三营，原本准备明年部署到拉脱维亚。总理卡尼10月19日在下议院发言，称议会正在共同哀悼，并下令联邦建筑物降半旗。军方少将表示，起初被认为已得到控制的草原火灾，因风向突然改变而变成致命大火。国防部官员称没有迹象显示涉及恐怖活动，加拿大军方与皇家骑警正在调查，国防部长麦金蒂说在事实查明之前，现在调整军事训练还为时过早。早期曾有消息称有7人死亡，后经国防部门确认为4人，起火原因仍有待查明。
summary.en: A fire broke out in a training area at CFB Wainwright in Alberta on the afternoon of October 17, killing four service members and injuring 39 others, at least 19 of them critically. The dead are Sgt. Morgan Wong and Privates Shaun Farrell, Aidan Goulding and Hayden Lykkemark, all from 3rd Battalion and preparing to deploy to Latvia next year. Prime Minister Mark Carney told the House of Commons on October 19 that Parliament met united in grief, and he ordered flags lowered on federal buildings. A military major-general said a fast-moving grass fire, thought to be contained, turned deadly when the wind shifted. A National Defence official said there were no signs of terrorist activity, and the military and the RCMP are investigating. Defence Minister David McGuinty said it is too soon to change training before the facts are known. Early reports of seven deaths were corrected to four, and the cause is still undetermined.

title.zh: 加拿大9月通胀升至3.1%，加息悬念升温
title.en: Canada's inflation rises to 3.1% as fuel prices climb

summary.zh: 加拿大统计局10月19日公布，9月年度通胀率升至3.1%，8月为3.0%。能源是主要推手：汽油价格同比上涨27.8%，燃料油上涨57.8%，而剔除汽油后的物价涨幅为2.2%。经济学家认为这一读数略低于预期，市场共识约为3.2%，同时核心通胀指标有所缓和，显示更高的能源成本尚未广泛传导到整体经济。加拿大央行将于10月28日公布下一次利率决定。多个机构对此存在分歧：道明经济学家预计利率将维持在2.25%不变，而包括蒙特利尔银行、加拿大皇家银行和德斯贾丁在内的机构则认为央行可能加息至2.5%。央行行长麦克勒姆表示，关键问题在于通胀是否会自行回落到目标水平。
summary.en: Statistics Canada said on October 19 that the annual inflation rate rose to 3.1 per cent in September, up from 3.0 per cent in August. Energy was the main driver: gasoline prices were up 27.8 per cent from a year earlier and fuel oil rose 57.8 per cent, while prices excluding gasoline rose 2.2 per cent. Economists said the reading was slightly below expectations, with consensus near 3.2 per cent, and core measures eased, suggesting higher energy costs have not yet spread widely. The Bank of Canada announces its next rate decision on October 28. Forecasters are split. TD Economics expects the rate to hold at 2.25 per cent, while BMO, RBC and Desjardins have said the bank could raise it to 2.5 per cent. Governor Tiff Macklem has said the core question is whether inflation will return to target on its own.

title.zh: 特朗普放弃禁售庞巴迪飞机的威胁
title.en: Trump drops threat against Canadian jet maker Bombardier

summary.zh: 美国总统特朗普10月20日在堪萨斯州表示，他不打算伤害加拿大飞机制造商庞巴迪，并说“我们会照顾好庞巴迪”的工人和岗位，等于放弃了此前禁止其飞机在美国销售的威胁。路透社报道称，特朗普说是共和党参议员罗杰·马歇尔的一通电话让他改变了立场。庞巴迪在堪萨斯州威奇托雇有约1500名员工，这场威胁在当地已成为政治议题。特朗普今年1月曾发出几乎相同的威胁，但没有下文，后来又在与卡尼的更大范围争端中重提，该争端涉及关税、破裂的贸易协议，以及他提出的加拿大成为美国第51个州的说法。报道指出，特朗普放弃的只是针对庞巴迪的威胁，并没有显示他在与卡尼的整体争端中让步，庞巴迪股价次日上涨4%。
summary.en: U.S. President Donald Trump said in Kansas on October 20 that he does not plan to hurt Canadian jet maker Bombardier, adding that he would take care of its workers and jobs. That drops his earlier threat to ban its aircraft from the American market. Reuters reported that Trump said a phone call from Kansas Republican Senator Roger Marshall changed his mind. Bombardier employs about 1,500 people in Wichita, and the threat had become a political issue there. Trump made an almost identical threat in January that went nowhere, and it returned as part of a broader fight with Prime Minister Mark Carney over tariffs, a collapsed trade deal and Trump's remarks about Canada becoming the 51st state. Reports stress that he dropped only the Bombardier threat, not the wider dispute, and Bombardier shares rose 4 per cent the next day.

title.zh: 卡尔加里公交车起火相撞：警方寻找离开现场的乘客
title.en: Calgary police seek passengers after fiery fatal bus crash

summary.zh: 10月15日，卡尔加里东北部Saddle Ridge社区发生一起涉及公交车的连环相撞事故并引发大火，造成3人死亡、16人受伤。《环球邮报》称事故涉及多辆车，一辆公交车撞上了另一辆。警方在第二辆公交车上发现3名死者，该车由天然气驱动，当局认为天然气是爆炸和随后起火的原因。法医办公室和消防调查人员仍在调查死因，警方表示现在判断是否与酒驾、超速或分心驾驶有关还为时过早，并呼吁在警方问话前离开现场的乘客主动联系。市议会和公交工会呼吁对这起致命事故展开彻底调查。不同来源对受伤者的严重程度说法略有出入。
summary.en: A chain-reaction crash involving Calgary transit buses and a fire in the city's northeast Saddle Ridge neighbourhood on October 15 left three people dead and 16 injured. The Globe and Mail described a collision of several vehicles in which one transit bus struck another. Police found three passengers dead on the second bus, which ran on natural gas, and authorities believe the gas caused the explosion and the fire that followed. Fire investigators and the Chief Medical Examiner's office are still examining the deaths. Police said it is too early to say whether impairment, speed or distraction played a role, and they are asking passengers who left the scene before speaking with officers to come forward. City council and the transit union have called for a thorough investigation. Sources differ slightly on how serious the injuries were.

title.zh: 魁北克新总理请副总督不要出席内阁宣誓
title.en: Quebec's incoming premier asks lieutenant-governor to skip cabinet swearing-in

summary.zh: 魁北克副总督曼侬·雅诺特将缺席新内阁的宣誓仪式，这是应即将上任的省总理保罗·圣皮埃尔·普拉蒙东的请求。这将是副总督首次不主持新政府内阁在国民议会的宣誓。誓词将由国民议会秘书长西格弗里德·彼得斯监督，雅诺特作为魁北克国玺的持有人，将在附近的办公室单独签署任命文件，以便部长们能立即开始工作。普拉蒙东在信中表示，他的政党坚定致力于废除魁北克的君主制，并承诺再通过一项法律取消副总督一职。魁北克议员在10月5日选举后选择不向查尔斯三世国王宣誓效忠，而只向魁北克人民宣誓，依据的是2022年的一项法律，其合宪性正在法庭受到挑战。若法院批准中止，拒绝宣誓的新议员可能在11月中旬议会复会时无法就座。
summary.en: Quebec Lieutenant-Governor Manon Jeannotte will skip the swearing-in of the new cabinet at the request of incoming premier Paul St-Pierre Plamondon. It will be the first time a lieutenant-governor does not preside over a new government's cabinet oath at the National Assembly. The oaths will be supervised by the Assembly's secretary general, Siegfried Peters, while Jeannotte, as keeper of the great seal, will sign the appointment documents separately from her nearby office so ministers can start work right away. In his letter, St-Pierre Plamondon said his party is firmly committed to abolishing the monarchy in Quebec and promised another law to eliminate the office of lieutenant-governor. After the October 5 election, Quebec's new members chose to swear allegiance only to the people of Quebec, not King Charles III, under a 2022 law now being challenged in court. If a stay is granted, members who refuse the oath could be barred from taking their seats when the legislature returns in mid-November.

title.zh: 绿党的彼得·弗莱击败肯·森，当选温哥华市长
title.en: Green's Pete Fry defeats incumbent Ken Sim to become Vancouver mayor

summary.zh: 在10月17日的卑诗省市政选举中，绿党的彼得·弗莱击败现任市长肯·森，当选温哥华市长。《环球邮报》、CBC、环球新闻和CTV均报道了这一结果，弗莱是首位当选加拿大主要城市市长的绿党人士。CBC报道说，在温哥华和素里等卑诗省最大城市，选民选择了新面孔，许多现任市长落选。森在败选后向弗莱表示祝贺，并说“我们其实互相喜欢”。CTV称，弗莱将领导一个主要由三个进步派政党代表组成的合作式市议会。选举当晚市议会的完整构成尚未最终确定，目前仅知道进步派阵营占据多数席位。
summary.en: Green candidate Pete Fry defeated incumbent Ken Sim in the October 17 B.C. municipal elections to become mayor of Vancouver, the Globe and Mail, CBC, Global News and CTV all reported. Fry is the first Green candidate elected to lead a major Canadian city. CBC reported that voters in the province's largest cities, including Vancouver and Surrey, opted for change, and many incumbent mayors lost their seats. Sim congratulated Fry after conceding, saying that they actually do like each other. CTV said Fry will lead a collaborative council made up largely of members of three progressive parties. The full makeup of council was not final on election night, but the progressive side holds most of the seats.

title.zh: 检方撤销对两名前安省警员2022年暴力逮捕案的指控
title.en: Crown drops charges against two former OPP officers over violent 2022 arrest

summary.zh: 据CTV巴里报道，检方已撤销对两名前安大略省警（OPP）警员斯科特·安东尼和伊桑·迈耶的所有刑事指控。撤诉在布雷斯布里奇法庭宣布，距离私人检控启动仅一个月。当事人理查德·达伦·摩根提起了私人检控，指两人伪造证据、妨碍司法并对他施暴。这起案件源于2022年7月10日凌晨三点在麦克蒂尔铁路场发生的一次暴力逮捕，监控录像拍下了过程，摩根称警员的说法与录像相矛盾。安东尼去年夏天在承认殴打该男子后辞职，获得有条件刑罚，没有入狱。摩根公开批评安省司法部长办公室的决定。目前报道没有说明检方撤诉的理由，也没有显示摩根是否会采取进一步法律行动。
summary.en: The Crown has dropped all criminal charges against two former Ontario Provincial Police officers, Scott Anthony and Ethan Meyer, over a violent 2022 arrest, CTV Barrie reported. The withdrawal was announced in Bracebridge court, one month after a private prosecution began. The complainant, Richard Darren Morgan, brought the private prosecution, alleging the officers fabricated evidence, obstructed justice and assaulted him. The case stems from a violent arrest at the MacTier railyard at 3 a.m. on July 10, 2022, which was recorded on surveillance video, and Morgan says the officers' version of events was contradicted by the footage. Anthony resigned last summer after pleading guilty to assaulting the man and received a conditional sentence with no jail time. Morgan publicly criticized the Attorney General's office over the decision. The reporting does not explain the Crown's reasons or say whether he will take further legal steps.

title.zh: 卑诗东北部一名皇家骑警被控持械伤害
title.en: Northeast B.C. RCMP officer charged with assault with a weapon

summary.zh: 卑诗省北落基山皇家骑警驻纳尔逊堡的警员马克西姆·平克被控一项持械伤害罪。卑诗省检控署批准了这项指控，涉案事件发生在2025年11月6日的纳尔逊堡，是一次执勤期间的事件。皇家骑警表示，平克已被调往行政岗位。一个外部皇家骑警单位负责刑事调查，同时一项关于行为守则的调查也已启动并仍在进行。事件的具体情形没有公布，检控署表示案件已进入司法程序，不会再提供更多信息。CBC报道，他的首次出庭定于10月26日在纳尔逊堡举行，另有媒体称日期为10月29日，多数来源支持10月26日。以上指控尚未在法庭上得到证实。
summary.en: Constable Maxim Pinke of the Northern Rockies RCMP in Fort Nelson, British Columbia, has been charged with one count of assault with a weapon over an on-duty incident. The BC Prosecution Service approved the charge, and the alleged incident took place in Fort Nelson on November 6, 2025. The RCMP say Pinke has been placed on administrative duties. An outside RCMP unit conducted the Criminal Code investigation, and a parallel Code of Conduct investigation was started and is continuing. Details of the circumstances were not released, and the prosecution service says it will give no more information because the case is before the courts. CBC reports his first court appearance is set for October 26 in Fort Nelson, though one outlet gives October 29. The charge is an allegation that has not been proven in court.

title.zh: 考伊琴土地所有权案上诉：各方警告停摆将引发“混乱局面”
title.en: Cowichan title appeal: appellants warn of a 'chaotic situation' for port, property and fishing

summary.zh: 在卑诗省具有里程碑意义的考伊琴原住民土地所有权案上诉中，多名上诉方向卑诗省上诉法院申请暂缓执行部分裁决，称这项裁决可能影响堤坝、私人财产、一个港口运输枢纽，以及其他原住民主张的水域中的捕鱼权。省政府、加拿大司法部长、港口、里士满市以及马斯魁姆和察瓦森原住民将于1月出庭，要求冻结裁决的特定部分。每项暂缓申请针对不同内容：捕鱼权声明、里士满市所拥有的完全产权土地上的原住民土地所有权，以及温哥华港口土地上的所有权。其中涉及私人财产和捕鱼权的部分已立即生效，而影响港口和里士满市的部分被法官杨暂缓18个月。里士满市要求“量身定制的暂缓”，以便在上诉终审前维持关键防洪设施。
summary.en: In the landmark appeal of the Cowichan Aboriginal title decision in British Columbia, several appellants have applied to the B.C. Court of Appeal to stay parts of the ruling, warning it could harm dikes, private property, a port transportation hub and fishing rights in waters claimed by other First Nations. The province, Canada's attorney general, the port, the City of Richmond and the Musqueam and Tsawwassen Nations will be in court in January asking for a freeze on certain parts of the ruling. Each stay application targets different parts: the declaration of fishing rights, Aboriginal title over certain fee-simple lands owned by Richmond, and title over Port of Vancouver lands. The part of the decision affecting private property and fishing rights took effect immediately, while Justice Barbara Young suspended the parts affecting the port and the City of Richmond for 18 months. Richmond is asking for a tailored stay so it can maintain critical flood protection pending a final decision on the appeal.
