title.zh: 安省签约冬季从美国进口电力，此前福特曾威胁断供
title.en: Ontario signs winter deal to import U.S. electricity after Ford's export threat

summary.zh: 安大略省已签署一份600兆瓦的合同，从纽约州进口电力，以应对即将到来的冬季。这份与美国公司Alpha Generation签订的合同将从11月1日开始，用于填补设备检修和冬季缺口，因为安省在最近一次容量拍卖中未能补足部分容量。省电力系统运营商IESO称这属于“正常的系统规划”，价格没有公开。电力将来自该公司位于美国东北部和加州的化石燃料设施，包括锡拉丘兹以北的奥斯威戈燃油发电机组。皮克林核电站正在进行多年翻修，已在9月关闭。这一消息发布于省长道格·福特数周前威胁切断对美电力出口之后，安大略清洁空气联盟等批评者称进口电力“更脏”，并与那一威胁相矛盾。最近的容量拍卖价格达到每兆瓦每个工作日725加元，为安省有史以来最高。
summary.en: Ontario has signed a 600-megawatt contract to import electricity from New York for the coming winter. The deal with U.S.-based Alpha Generation starts November 1 and is meant to cover maintenance and winter shortfalls after Ontario missed some capacity in its latest auction. The province's grid operator, the IESO, calls it part of normal system planning, and the price was not disclosed. The power will come from the company's fossil-fuel facilities in the U.S. Northeast and California, including the Oswego oil-fired plant north of Syracuse. The Pickering nuclear plant is in a multi-year refurbishment and was shut down in September. The news comes weeks after Premier Doug Ford floated cutting electricity exports to the United States. Critics, including the Ontario Clean Air Alliance, called the imports dirty and at odds with that threat. Recent capacity auction prices hit $725 per megawatt per business day, the highest ever in Ontario.

title.zh: 多伦多布鲁尔西街自行车道拆除引发抗议，已有4人被捕
title.en: Fourth arrest as Bloor Street West bike lane removal protests continue

summary.zh: 据多伦多警方说，埃托比科克布鲁尔西街自行车道拆除工程引发的抗议已导致4人被捕。雅虎新闻加拿大10月19日报道第四人被捕；CP24此前在10月15日报道了第三人被捕。其中第一名和第三名被捕者被控妨碍警务人员和恶作剧罪，第二名被控恶作剧和价值5000加元以下的盗窃罪。10月14日，一名女子在下午1点后因妨碍和平官员及恶作剧被捕，警方警告抗议者，如果干扰拆除工作可能面临刑事指控。施工在警方保护下推进，涉及长约1.2公里的路段，预计11月完工。省府以缓解拥堵为由推动拆除，批评者认为这会让骑车人更不安全，也反对省政府越权。
summary.en: Protests against the removal of the Bloor Street West bike lanes in Etobicoke have led to four arrests, according to Toronto police. Yahoo News Canada reported the fourth arrest on October 19, after CP24 reported a third on October 15. The first and third people were charged with obstructing police and mischief, and the second with mischief and theft under $5,000. On October 14, a woman was arrested just after 1 p.m. for obstructing a peace officer and mischief, and police warned protesters they could face criminal charges if they interfere with the work. The removal is going ahead under police protection on a 1.2-kilometre stretch and is expected to finish in November. The province cites congestion as its reason. Critics say it will make the corridor less safe for cyclists and object to what they call provincial overreach.

title.zh: 皮尔斯警方破获豪车劫案团伙：10人被捕、128项指控
title.en: Peel police arrest 10, lay 128 charges in violent carjacking network

summary.zh: 皮尔区警察局10月19日公布代号“高度戒备”（Project High Guard）行动的结果：警方逮捕10人，提出128项指控。调查把2025年6月至2026年4月间的21起事件与一个在大多伦多地区实施劫车和盗窃高档车的网络联系起来，部分案件中嫌犯亮出刀具和枪支，受害者被殴打，有人受重伤。警方在9月3日展开搜查，被捕者包括两名17岁少年，被指控最多的嫌疑人泰维恩·科利面临44项指控，包括抢劫、严重伤害和参与犯罪组织。警方追回15辆被盗车辆，价值约140万加元，并缴获四支非法枪支及弹药。警察局长杜赖亚皮表示，部分被告当时已处于保释状态，其中许多人很可能再次获释。
summary.en: Peel Regional Police announced the results of Project High Guard on October 19: 10 people arrested and 128 charges laid. Police tied 21 incidents between June 2025 and April 2026 to a network behind carjackings and thefts of high-end vehicles in the GTA. In some cases knives and firearms were brandished, victims were assaulted and some were severely injured. Raids took place on September 3, and those arrested include two 17-year-olds. The most-charged suspect, Tayvien Coley, faces 44 charges, including robbery, aggravated assault and participating in a criminal organization. Police recovered 15 stolen vehicles worth about $1.4 million and seized four illegal firearms along with ammunition. Chief Nishan Duraiappah said a few of the accused were already on a form of release, and many of them will likely be released again.

title.zh: 皮尔逊机场黄金大劫案审讯：关键证人称记不清许多对话
title.en: Pearson gold heist trial: key witness says he cannot recall many conversations

summary.zh: 皮尔逊机场黄金大劫案的审讯正在布兰普顿进行，被告为前加航员工帕尔帕尔·西杜，他否认盗窃5000加元以上和串谋犯可公诉罪行的指控。检方律师称他是掌握内部知识和权限的“内应”之一，指控他用自己的账号打印了一份伪造的空运单。关键证人阿尔萨兰·乔杜里已认罪，正在服四年刑期，他作证说，自己告诉西杜卡车和司机已经就位，西杜回答“好”，但他后来又说，由于创伤后应激障碍，他无法回忆起早前陈述中的许多对话。警方说，2023年4月机场共有6600根金条被盗，重量超过400公斤。另一名被告阿奇特·格罗弗预计下个月受审。
summary.en: The trial of Parmpal Sidhu, a former Air Canada employee, is under way in Brampton over the 2023 gold heist at Toronto Pearson airport. He has pleaded not guilty to theft over $5,000 and conspiracy to commit an indictable offence. Crown attorney Jelena Vlacic called him one of the inside men with the knowledge and access to help carry out the heist and alleges he printed a fraudulent air waybill using his own profile. The key witness, Arsalan Chaudhary, is serving a four-year sentence after pleading guilty. He testified that he told Sidhu the truck and driver were ready and that Sidhu replied OK, but later said he could not recall many conversations from his earlier statements, blaming PTSD. Police say 6,600 gold bars weighing more than 400 kilograms were stolen in April 2023. Another accused man, Archit Grover, is expected to face trial next month.

title.zh: 多伦多市中心枪击致一名50多岁男子重伤
title.en: Man seriously injured in downtown Toronto shooting

summary.zh: 10月20日凌晨1点前，多伦多市中心的舍伯恩街与威尔斯利街附近发生枪击案，一名50多岁的男子被送往医院，伤势严重但不危及生命。CTV报道，多伦多警方随后逮捕了两名嫌疑人，并公布两人分别为22岁的贾·托马斯·威廉姆斯和20岁的拉沙诺·马基。较早的CTV和CP24报道说，当时只有一名20多岁的男子在现场被捕，另一名嫌疑人在逃，后续报道则显示第二人已被捕。据CTV，警方在现场缴获两支已上膛的枪支。两人面临严重伤害和枪支罪名，马基还被控违反释放令和违反缓刑条件。不同报道在逮捕人数上有出入，最终细节以警方通报为准。
summary.en: A man in his 50s was shot near Sherbourne and Wellesley streets in downtown Toronto shortly before 1 a.m. on Tuesday, October 20. He was taken to hospital with serious but non-life-threatening injuries. CTV News reported that Toronto police later arrested two suspects and named them as 22-year-old Jah Thomas Williams and 20-year-old Lashano Mackey. Earlier CTV and CP24 reports said only one man in his 20s was arrested at the scene and a second suspect was outstanding, so the accounts changed as the story developed. According to CTV, police recovered two loaded firearms at the scene. Both men face charges including aggravated assault and firearm offences, and Mackey is also charged with failing to comply with a release order and breach of probation. Reports differed on the number of arrests, so police statements should be treated as the final word.

title.zh: “南方计划”腐败案：多伦多警员获有条件释放
title.en: Toronto officer gets conditional discharge in Project South case

summary.zh: 多伦多警员埃利亚斯·穆瓦德因在“南方计划”（Project South）警方腐败调查中承认未经授权使用计算机，10月19日被判有条件释放。他将接受一年缓刑，并完成100小时社区服务。有条件释放意味着他被认定有罪，但如果遵守缓刑条件，将不会留下刑事记录。根据双方同意的事实陈述，他应前雇主的要求进行了非法的车牌查询；另一说法是为朋友查询车牌。检方原本寻求四个月刑期，包括两个月软禁和两个月宵禁，外加至少一年缓刑。辩护律师彼得·布劳蒂称，他的当事人没有参与该案中指控的严重不当行为，只是被卷了进去。另一起相关案件中，退休警员德里克·麦考密克此前因渎职和盗窃被判10个月有条件刑期。
summary.en: Toronto police Const. Elias Mouawad received a conditional discharge on October 19 after pleading guilty to unauthorized use of a computer in the Project South police corruption investigation. He will serve one year of probation and complete 100 hours of community service. A conditional discharge means he was found guilty but will not have a criminal record if he follows the conditions. According to an agreed statement of facts, he ran an illegal licence plate search at the request of a former employer, while another account says it was for a friend. The Crown had sought a four-month sentence, with two months of house arrest and two months of curfew, plus at least a year of probation. His lawyer, Peter Brauti, said his client was not involved in the serious misconduct alleged in the larger file but got caught up in it. In a separate Project South case, retired constable Derek McCormick received a 10-month conditional sentence.

title.zh: 三名加军成员涉多伦多加密货币绑架案，共7人被控82项罪名
title.en: Three Canadian Armed Forces members among seven charged in Toronto crypto kidnapping

summary.zh: 多伦多警方就今年7月一起加密货币交易所老板被绑架案共指控7名男子，提出82项指控，其中包括3名加拿大武装部队成员。警方称，受害人7月25日在芬奇东街与贝维尤大道附近被人持枪劫持，遭戴上手铐并殴打，劫匪试图获取他的加密货币资产和公司安保系统，随后警告他不要报警并将其释放。警方点名的三名军人为22岁的塔拉拉姆巴盖·费尔南多、29岁的詹姆斯·莫罗和24岁的杰克·迈利。搜查缴获了含3D打印部件的枪支、两支消音器、GPS追踪器和约2700发弹药，其中约2500发后被确认为军方被盗弹药，军方没有向警方报案。国防部已启动独立的军事警察调查，并检讨弹药库存管控。警察局长米隆·德姆基夫对嫌犯所具备的训练水平表示担忧。以上均为指控，尚未在法庭上得到证实。
summary.en: Toronto police have charged seven men with 82 offences over the July abduction of a cryptocurrency exchange owner, and three of the accused are members of the Canadian Armed Forces. Police say the victim was seized at gunpoint near Finch Avenue East and Bayview Avenue on July 25, handcuffed and assaulted while the group tried to reach his crypto holdings and business security systems, then released with a warning not to contact police. Police named the three soldiers as Talarambage Fernando, 22, James Moreau, 29, and Jack Miley, 24. Searches turned up firearms with 3D-printed parts, two silencers, GPS trackers, drugs and about 2,700 rounds of ammunition, roughly 2,500 of which were later found to be military ammunition that had not been reported stolen. National Defence has launched an independent military police probe and is reviewing ammunition controls. Chief Myron Demkiw raised concern about the level of training allegedly brought to the crime. The charges are allegations and have not been proven in court.

title.zh: 安省市政选举10月26日投票，多伦多提前投票人数大增
title.en: Ontario votes in municipal elections on October 26 as Toronto advance turnout jumps

summary.zh: 安大略省市政选举将于10月26日周一举行，多伦多的投票站当天上午10点至晚上8点开放。CBC报道，多伦多提前投票人数在10月6日至11日期间超过22.2万，比2023年补选高出近72%。Liaison Strategies在提前投票期间所做的民调显示，现任市长欧琳娜（Olivia Chow）以五个百分点领先挑战者布拉德·布拉德福德。在密西沙加，现任市长卡罗琳·帕里什将参选，她在2024年补选中赢得大约两年的任期，挑战者包括市议员迪皮卡·达梅拉和阿尔文·泰德乔。在布兰普顿，现任市长帕特里克·布朗于5月1日确认将寻求连任，其他登记候选人包括贾格鲁蒂·巴特、古迪普·辛格·多塔尔和维迪亚·萨加尔·高塔姆。各城市的提前投票日期不同，选民应以各市官方网站为准。
summary.en: Ontario's municipal elections are on Monday, October 26, and polling places in Toronto are open from 10 a.m. to 8 p.m. CBC reported that advance voter turnout in Toronto topped 222,000 between October 6 and 11, a jump of nearly 72 per cent over the 2023 byelection. A Liaison Strategies survey taken during advance voting suggests incumbent Mayor Olivia Chow leads challenger Brad Bradford by five points. In Mississauga, incumbent Mayor Carolyn Parrish, who won the 2024 byelection for a roughly two-year term, is running, with councillors Dipika Damerla and Alvin Tedjo among the challengers. In Brampton, incumbent Patrick Brown confirmed on May 1 that he would seek re-election, and other registered candidates include Jagruti Bhatt, Gurdeep Singh Dhothar and Vidya Sagar Gautam. Advance voting dates differed across cities, so voters should check each city's official site.

title.zh: 美国
title.en: United States

title.zh: 美股收盘：3M财报带动道指大涨逾500点
title.en: Wall Street close: Dow jumps 530 points on 3M earnings

summary.zh: 10月20日，美股收盘涨跌互现，道琼斯工业平均指数上涨约530点，涨幅1.02%，收于52,495.88点。标普500指数上涨0.28%，收于7,712.57点；纳斯达克综合指数微跌0.02%，收于26,424.82点，大型科技股表现落后。罗素2000小盘股指数上涨1.65%至2,773.42点，领涨主要指数，纽约证交所上涨股票与下跌股票之比为1,614比559。3M公司第三季度盈利好于预期并上调全年业绩预期，股价上涨约5%至6%，带动道指走高，报道称其调整后每股收益增长12%至2.50美元，全年预期上调至9.10至9.15美元。部分媒体还把涨势与3M同亚马逊扩大数据中心业务合作联系起来。不同来源对纳斯达克跌幅的表述略有差异。
summary.en: U.S. stocks closed mixed on October 20, led by the Dow Jones Industrial Average, which rose about 530 points, or 1.02 per cent, to 52,495.88. The S&P 500 gained 0.28 per cent to 7,712.57, while the Nasdaq Composite slipped 0.02 per cent to 26,424.82 as megacap tech lagged. The small-cap Russell 2000 led the major indexes, up 1.65 per cent to 2,773.42, and NYSE advancers outnumbered decliners 1,614 to 559. Shares of 3M jumped roughly 5 to 6 per cent after the company beat third-quarter estimates and raised its full-year guidance, giving the Dow a boost. Adjusted earnings per share rose 12 per cent to $2.50, and 3M lifted its 2026 range to $9.10 to $9.15. Some coverage also tied the rally to an expanded commercial relationship with Amazon on data-center products. Sources differ slightly on the exact size of the Nasdaq's decline.

title.zh: 中期选举前两周，特朗普赴北卡罗来纳为惠特利助选
title.en: Two weeks from the midterms, Trump rallies in North Carolina for Whatley

summary.zh: 距11月3日中期选举还有两周，特朗普10月20日在北卡罗来纳州格林维尔集会，为共和党参议员候选人迈克尔·惠特利助选。惠特利对阵前民主党州长罗伊·库珀，争夺一个空缺的参议院席位；NBC新闻称惠特利在近期民调中落后，将该选战评为“倾向民主党”。特朗普在集会上抨击库珀的刑事司法记录并提及1988年的威利·霍顿案，也批评他处理飓风重建的方式，还称库珀是“超级自由派的反社会者”。他告诉听众“你们应该去投票”，并重申如果共和党赢得中期选举，每位美国成年人将获得5000美元，但没有说明资金来源。惠特利本人表示，如果他输给库珀，就意味着民主党将夺回参议院控制权。特朗普说，他计划在选举前再次回到这个竞争激烈的州。
summary.en: With the November 3 midterms two weeks away, President Donald Trump rallied in Greenville, North Carolina, on October 20 for Republican Senate candidate Michael Whatley. Whatley faces former Democratic Governor Roy Cooper for an open seat, and NBC News reports Whatley is trailing in recent polls and rates the race likely Democratic. Trump attacked Cooper's criminal-justice record, invoking the 1988 Willie Horton case, criticized his handling of hurricane recovery and called him a super liberal sociopath. He told the crowd that they should vote and repeated a promise that every American adult would receive $5,000 if Republicans win the midterms, without saying how it would be funded. Whatley himself said that if he loses to Cooper, it would mean Democrats flipping control of the Senate. Trump said he plans to return to the hotly contested state before Election Day.

title.zh: 法国骚乱成为特朗普中期选举的新话题
title.en: Rioting in France becomes a new talking point for Trump's midterm push

summary.zh: CNN报道，法国的骚乱给特朗普在中期选举中试图止住共和党颓势提供了新话题。特朗普的集会播放了法国暴力画面，其中多数剪自福克斯新闻，一些顾问把这场动荡视为可能帮助共和党的“十月惊奇”。他在堪萨斯州说，法国的动荡是民主党获胜后美国可能发生情况的警告，并归咎于移民和“全球主义左翼政客”，福克斯新闻则引述他称“移民占领了法国”、应“尽快关闭边境”。副总统万斯在社交平台上也把暴力归咎于移民。CNN指出，几乎没有证据显示周末的暴力由非法移民或任何移民实施，示威起初是学生要求改善学校经费，随后工会等团体因生活成本高企和燃油价格创纪录而加入。CNN称有一名警察和一名抗议者死亡；福克斯新闻则报道近1000名法国警察受伤、约2400人被捕。
summary.en: Rioting in France has handed Donald Trump a new talking point as he tries to stave off Republican losses in the midterms, CNN reported. Footage of the violence, much of it clipped from Fox News, has been shown at his rallies, and some advisers see the unrest as a possible October surprise. In Kansas, Trump said the French unrest was a warning of what could happen in the United States if Democrats win, blaming immigration and globalist left-wing politicians, and Fox News quoted him saying migrants have taken over France and urging leaders to close the borders fast. Vice President JD Vance also blamed immigration on social media. CNN notes there is little evidence the weekend violence was carried out by immigrants of any kind. It began as a student movement over school funding, and unions and other groups joined over high living costs and record fuel prices. CNN reports one police officer and one protester died, while Fox News reports nearly 1,000 officers injured and about 2,400 arrests.

title.zh: 特朗普在法庭听证后称华盛顿高尔夫球场为“垃圾岛”
title.en: Trump calls D.C. golf course 'Trash Island' after heated court hearing

summary.zh: 特朗普正试图关闭并翻新华盛顿的东波托马克高尔夫球场，这一计划已陷入诉讼，自然保护人士和高尔夫球手试图阻止他改变这个公共公园。法官安娜·雷耶斯发布命令，要求政府在对球场作出任何“不可逆转的改动”前至少提前三天通知。在10月19日的听证会上，讨论超出了砍树本身，延伸到特朗普的社交媒体帖子，以及法院能在多大程度上向政府追问答案；雷耶斯对司法部律师说：“我不知道该怎么办，因为我不断听到不同的说法。”听证会后，特朗普发布了碎片、积水和损坏围栏的照片，称之为“供法官研究的垃圾岛照片”，说那只是“一小块地方，比有些地方还好”，并称法官“疯了”。一份报道称，政府承认曾把该地用作白宫东翼拆除垃圾的倾倒场。
summary.en: President Trump is trying to close and renovate East Potomac Golf Links in Washington, D.C., a plan already tied up in litigation, with preservationists and golfers trying to stop him from changing the public park. Judge Ana Reyes ordered the government to give at least three days' notice before making any irreparable modification to the course. At Monday's hearing, October 19, the discussion went beyond tree removal to Trump's social media posts and how far the court can press the administration for answers. I don't know what to do, when I keep getting different stories, Reyes told a Justice Department lawyer. After the hearing, Trump posted photos of debris, flooding and damaged fences, calling them pictures of Trash Island for the judge to study. He said it was just a small area and better than some, and called the judge insane. One report says the administration has admitted using the site as a dumping ground for debris from the White House East Wing demolition.

title.zh: 万斯拒绝为内塔尼亚胡连任背书，与特朗普立场不同
title.en: Vance declines to endorse Netanyahu's reelection, breaking with Trump

summary.zh: 副总统万斯10月19日拒绝表态是否支持本雅明·内塔尼亚胡的连任，此前一天特朗普刚刚为这位以色列总理背书。万斯说，他只为美国候选人背书，目前专注于中期选举；他还说他并不反对为内塔尼亚胡背书，也并不赞成，不会介入以色列选举。特朗普已将“完全而彻底”的支持给予内塔尼亚胡。以色列大选定于10月27日举行。多家媒体指出，这一表态发生在犹太裔美国人群体和美以同盟都十分敏感的时期，中期选举前反犹主义的担忧在两党中都有上升。CNN、福克斯新闻、《华盛顿邮报》和《时代》周刊等均报道了此事，并把它视为万斯与总统之间的一个罕见分歧。
summary.en: Vice President JD Vance on Monday, October 19, declined to say whether he backs Benjamin Netanyahu's reelection bid, a day after President Trump endorsed the Israeli prime minister. Vance said he endorses American candidates and is focused on the midterms. He added that he was not against endorsing Netanyahu and not for it either, and that he is not getting involved in Israeli elections. Trump has put his complete and total support behind Netanyahu, and Israel's election is set for October 27. Several outlets noted that the exchange came at an extraordinarily sensitive time for Jewish Americans and for the U.S.-Israel alliance, with concern about antisemitism rising across the political spectrum ahead of the midterms. CNN, Fox News, The Washington Post and Time all covered the story, and several framed it as a rare split between the vice president and the president.

title.zh: 据报道，奥马尔的姐姐在住所被搜查后接受联邦调查人员问话
title.en: Ilhan Omar's sister reportedly questioned by federal investigators

summary.zh: 福克斯新闻数字版及多家媒体援引知情人士报道，美国国会议员伊尔汗·奥马尔的姐姐萨赫拉·努尔上周自愿与联邦调查人员谈话。此事发生在10月12日联邦人员搜查奥马尔位于华盛顿的住所之后，此案属于移民欺诈调查，据报道调查重点是奥马尔或其父亲在入籍文件上是否提供了虚假信息。具体问了什么、她说了什么，目前并不清楚。此前有报道称努尔和其他几人收到传票，《纽约时报》还报道她的手机被扣押；奥马尔的手机、护照和电脑据称也被带走。奥马尔称这次搜查有政治动机。努尔住在肯尼亚，当时在美国宣传新书，明尼苏达州一场活动因“家庭紧急情况”被取消。以上内容主要来自福克斯新闻的报道，尚未得到独立证实。
summary.en: Fox News Digital and other outlets, citing people familiar with the probe, report that Rep. Ilhan Omar's older sister, Sahra Noor, voluntarily spoke with federal investigators last week. The interview followed the October 12 raid on Omar's Washington home as part of an immigration fraud investigation, which reportedly centres on whether Omar or her father gave false information on her citizenship paperwork. What investigators asked, and what Noor said, remains unclear. Earlier reports said Noor and several others had received subpoenas, and The New York Times reported her phone was seized. Agents reportedly took Omar's phone, passport and computer as well, and Omar has called the raid politically motivated. Noor lives in Kenya and had been in the U.S. promoting a book, and a Minnesota event was cancelled over a family emergency. The reporting comes mostly from Fox News and has not been independently confirmed.

title.zh: 奈飞财报超预期，但营收指引令股价盘后下挫
title.en: Netflix beats Q3 estimates but shares fall on weak outlook

summary.zh: 奈飞10月20日公布第三季度业绩，营收约128.7亿美元，大致符合预期，摊薄后每股收益0.87美元，高于分析师预期的0.82美元，营业利润率为34.6%，高于公司此前指引的33.2%。但公司对第四季度营收的预测低于华尔街预期，并将全年广告收入目标下调约3亿美元至27亿美元；季度营收增速为11.8%，是近三年来最慢。受此影响，奈飞股价在盘后交易中下跌约4%至6%，常规交易收盘价为68.69美元，盘后报价在约64.62至65.97美元之间。奈飞股价今年以来已下跌约25%。该公司此前还宣布裁员约1000人并调整管理层。投资者关注的是，奈飞能否稳住放缓的营收增长。
summary.en: Netflix reported third-quarter results on October 20 with revenue of about $12.87 billion, roughly in line with forecasts, and diluted earnings of 87 cents a share, above the 82 cents analysts expected. Operating margin reached 34.6 per cent, above the 33.2 per cent the company had guided to. But its fourth-quarter revenue outlook fell short of Wall Street expectations, and it cut its annual advertising target by about $300 million to $2.7 billion. Quarterly revenue growth of 11.8 per cent was the slowest in nearly three years. Shares fell roughly 4 to 6 per cent in after-hours trading, from a regular-session close of $68.69, with quotes between about $64.62 and $65.97. The stock is down about 25 per cent this year. The company has also announced about 1,000 job cuts and leadership changes, and investors want proof that it can stabilize slowing revenue growth.

title.zh: 库克政治报告调整多场选战评级，民主党略占上风
title.en: Cook Political Report shifts three Senate races as Democrats gain ground

summary.zh: 库克政治报告10月20日调整了三场参议院选战的评级：南卡罗来纳州和密西西比州向民主党倾斜，明尼苏达州向共和党靠拢。此前，该机构在10月16日把11个众议院选区向民主党方向调整，多数位于传统共和党地盘，其中共和党仍在8个选区占优，近半数调整集中在俄亥俄、内布拉斯加和堪萨斯；10月9日又调整了18个选区，预测民主党将净增9至19个席位。分析师把变化归因于选民对经济的不满、特朗普支持率低迷，以及对伊朗战争的不满。CNN的分析文章则提醒，近期民调让一些民主党人期待在深红地区获胜，但任何低于“蓝色浪潮”的结果都可能被视为失败。库克认为目前有36个选区具有竞争力，而2018年同期为49个。
summary.en: The Cook Political Report on October 20 changed its ratings for three Senate races, moving South Carolina and Mississippi toward Democrats and Minnesota toward Republicans. On October 16 it moved 11 House races toward Democrats, mostly in traditional Republican strongholds, with Republicans still favoured in eight of them and nearly half of the moves in Ohio, Nebraska and Kansas. On October 9 it shifted 18 races and projected a net Democratic gain of nine to 19 seats. Analysts point to voter frustration with the economy, Trump's weak polling and disapproval of the Iran war. A CNN analysis warns that recent polls have some Democrats imagining wins in deeply red territory, and anything short of a blue wave could look like a loss. Cook considers 36 districts competitive now, compared with 49 at this point in the 2018 wave cycle.

title.zh: 伊朗袭击霍尔木兹油轮，布伦特原油升破110美元
title.en: Brent crude tops $110 as Iran steps up attacks on Hormuz tankers

summary.zh: 油价因霍尔木兹海峡的油轮遇袭而攀升，布伦特原油一度创下约五个月来的高位。报道称，布伦特10月19日交易于约109.68美元，西德克萨斯中质原油约98.55美元；另一份报道称，周二布伦特结算价为108.79美元，盘中曾触及111.99美元的高点。分析人士把涨势与伊朗对油轮的袭击联系在一起，有报道称过去两周至少有18艘船只在海峡遇袭，凯普勒数据显示出口流量再度受到冲击。不过估算存在分歧：《华尔街日报》的报道称中东流量超过战前水平，凯普勒则把霍尔木兹的流量估为每日850万桶，另有分析认为实际供应稳定，价格反映的是地缘政治风险溢价。巴基斯坦和卡塔尔正在斡旋，但没有迹象显示协议已近在眼前。
summary.en: Oil prices climbed on attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz, with Brent crude reaching its highest level in about five months. Brent traded around $109.68 a barrel on October 19, with West Texas Intermediate near $98.55, and another report said Brent settled at $108.79 on Tuesday after touching a high of $111.99. Analysts tie the rally to Iranian strikes on tankers, with one report saying at least 18 vessels have come under attack in the strait over the past two weeks, and Kpler data showing export rates hit again. Estimates diverge, though. A Wall Street Journal report cited Middle East flows topping pre-war levels, Kpler put Hormuz flows at 8.5 million barrels a day, and another analysis said actual supply remains stable and prices reflect a geopolitical risk premium. Pakistan and Qatar are mediating, but reports of progress did not show that an agreement was close.

title.zh: 俄亥俄州长竞选胶着：民调各说各话
title.en: Ohio governor's race tightens with conflicting polls and attack ads

summary.zh: 俄亥俄州州长选战中，民主党的艾米·阿克顿与共和党的维韦克·拉马斯瓦米竞争激烈，选举日是11月3日。马里斯特民调在10月15至18日访问近1200名可能投票者，显示阿克顿以50%对43%领先；ActiVote周一发布的民调则显示拉马斯瓦米领先2.8个百分点，但只访问了400人，误差为正负4.9个百分点。CNN/SSRS此前的民调显示阿克顿领先8点；Pollsmax的平均值是阿克顿47.5%对44.9%领先。库克政治报告在7月把该选战由“倾向共和党”调为“势均力敌”，萨巴托的水晶球同样评为“势均力敌”。拉马斯瓦米阵营播出一则广告，出现一名自称是阿克顿失散母亲的女子，阿克顿则指责对方可能违反纽约律师注册规定或俄亥俄选举法。
summary.en: Ohio's governor's race between Democrat Amy Acton and Republican Vivek Ramaswamy is tight, with Election Day on November 3. A Marist poll conducted October 15 to 18 among nearly 1,200 likely voters has Acton ahead 50 per cent to 43 per cent. An ActiVote poll released Monday goes the other way, showing Ramaswamy up 2.8 points, though it surveyed only 400 voters with a margin of error of 4.9 points. An earlier CNN/SSRS poll had Acton up 8 points, and the Pollsmax average has her ahead 47.5 to 44.9. The Cook Political Report moved the race from lean Republican to toss-up in July, and Sabato's Crystal Ball also rates it a toss-up. Ramaswamy's campaign aired an ad featuring a woman who said she was Acton's estranged mother, and Acton responded by accusing Ramaswamy of either violating New York attorney registration rules or breaking Ohio voting law.

title.zh: 欧洲
title.en: Europe

title.zh: 法国骚乱降温：巴黎等城市实施宵禁，政府承认应对失误
title.en: France protests cool after curfews as government admits shortcomings

summary.zh: 在巴黎和其他主要城市实施夜间宵禁后，法国全国性骚乱有所降温，总理塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔尼称宵禁起到了恢复一定平静的作用。内政部长洛朗·努涅斯说，已有2513人被拘留，67人被关押，约6万名警察和其他安保力量被部署，但在巴黎、马赛和里昂等城市仍未能完全压制骚乱。巴黎警察局长帕特里斯·福尔说，宵禁将持续到有必要为止，200名调查人员正在查找参与打砸抢的人。勒科尔尼指责极左团体策划“暴动性”行动，同时承认政府存在失误，包括情报失灵和警力部署过于被动，努涅斯表示他承担自己的那一部分责任。军队将支援警方，应对本周六的新一轮抗议，勒科尔尼承诺投入“大规模”警力。骚乱与生活成本高企有关，发生在法国总统选举前约六个月。
summary.en: Nationwide unrest in France has cooled after overnight curfews in Paris and other major cities, Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu said, crediting the curfews with restoring a measure of calm. Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez reported 2,513 people taken into custody and 67 imprisoned, with around 60,000 police and other security forces deployed, though authorities could not fully suppress riots in cities such as Paris, Marseille and Lyon. Paris Police Chief Patrice Faure said the curfew continues for as long as necessary and that 200 investigators are working to identify those behind break-ins and looting. Lecornu accused far-left groups of planning an insurrectionary effort, but also admitted shortcomings in the government's response, citing intelligence failures and static police deployments, and Nuñez said he accepted his share of responsibility. Military forces will support police ahead of protests set for this Saturday, and Lecornu promised a massive police presence. The unrest is tied to the cost of living and comes about six months before France votes for a successor to President Macron.

title.zh: 生活成本抗议蔓延至意大利：米兰发生打砸抢
title.en: Cost-of-living protest turns violent in Milan as unrest spreads across Italy

summary.zh: 10月17日，意大利米兰一场反对战争和生活成本上涨的游行最初平和，随后戴口罩的抗议者向防暴警察投掷石块和铺路砖，并点燃用酒吧桌子搭成的路障。警方使用水炮和催泪瓦斯驱散人群。据拉普雷斯通讯社报道，至少两名警察受伤，约50名示威者被拘留，其中许多是未成年人；有人洗劫商店、纵火，杜奥莫广场和一座高档购物长廊一度被清空。博洛尼亚和都灵也发生冲突，造成警察受伤，据警察工会说，博洛尼亚有56名警察受伤。总理梅洛尼在社交平台上说，执法人员必须面对犯罪分子的暴力，这些人利用示威寻求对抗、制造混乱。米兰市长朱塞佩·萨拉称抗议原因可以理解，但谴责暴力和破坏。欧洲新闻台报道，意大利将“非常坚决”地回应，提出预防性拘留和禁止集会等措施。
summary.en: A march in Milan on October 17 against wars and rising living costs began peacefully, but masked protesters then threw stones and paving blocks at riot police and set fire to barricades built from bar tables. Police used water cannons and tear gas to disperse the crowds. LaPresse reported at least two officers injured and around 50 demonstrators detained, many of them minors, while rioters looted stores and set fires, emptying Piazza del Duomo and a luxury shopping arcade. Clashes also broke out in Bologna and Turin, injuring police, and a police union said 56 officers were hurt in Bologna. Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni wrote on X that law enforcement had to face the violence of criminals who exploit demonstrations to seek confrontation and sow chaos. Milan Mayor Giuseppe Sala said the reasons were understandable but condemned the violence and damage. Euronews reported that Italy will respond with great firmness, with preventive detention and bans on gatherings proposed.

title.zh: 风暴“亚当”袭击西班牙东部，至少5人死亡
title.en: Storm Adam kills at least five and forces thousands to evacuate in eastern Spain

summary.zh: 风暴“亚当”袭击西班牙东部，造成严重洪灾。法新社报道，风暴周二开始减弱，此前已造成至少5人死亡；不同来源给出的死亡人数在3至5人之间。暴雨从周六开始，瓦伦西亚地区部分地方24小时内降雨量高达每平方米700升。据报道，约2000人被疏散，10月19日一天就有超过1000起救援。早期报道称瓦伦西亚地区有3人死亡，加泰罗尼亚一名35岁的女子周六被洪水冲走。The Watchers网站说，一名农民和马拉加附近另一人的死亡因未确认与风暴有关，未计入四人的统计。报道把这场灾害与2024年瓦伦西亚地区造成230多人死亡的洪灾相比较。由于当局仍在核实，死亡人数可能还会变化。
summary.en: Storm Adam hit eastern Spain with severe flooding. AFP reported that the storm began to ease on Tuesday after leaving at least five people dead, though counts from different sources range from three to five. The downpour began on Saturday and dumped as much as 700 litres of rain per square metre in 24 hours in parts of the Valencia region. Around 2,000 people were reported evacuated, and there were more than 1,000 rescues on October 19 alone. Early reports cited three deaths in the Valencia region, and a 35-year-old woman in Catalonia was swept away by floodwaters on Saturday. The Watchers site said the deaths of a farmer and of another person near Malaga were left out of its count of four because they were not confirmed as storm-related. Coverage drew comparisons with the 2024 floods that killed more than 230 people in the Valencia region. The toll may change as authorities confirm figures.

title.zh: 立陶宛境内无人机爆炸：波兰要求乌克兰给出解释
title.en: Poland demands explanation from Ukraine over drone that exploded in Lithuania

summary.zh: 10月18日，一架无人机从波兰一侧进入立陶宛领空后爆炸，损坏了一辆行驶中的汽车，没有人员受伤。乌克兰表示道歉，并称这可能是俄罗斯电子干扰把乌克兰无人机偏离了原定目标的又一例，当时它们正在对俄罗斯境内军事目标发动行动。波兰总理图斯克说，波兰将与立陶宛密切合作，并期待乌克兰全面配合，同时强调没有外国可以未经华沙明确同意就在波兰领土或领空开展军事行动。事实仍有不清楚之处：立陶宛的调查结果显示无人机穿过了波兰领空，但波兰军方雷达起初没有显示相应的越境，波兰至今没有发布最终军事结论。波兰和立陶宛国防部已成立联合小组调查。一家波兰媒体援引非官方说法称无人机从立陶宛起飞，波兰国防部予以否认，立陶宛当局也加以驳斥。
summary.en: A drone that entered Lithuanian airspace from the Polish side exploded on October 18, damaging a moving car, with no injuries reported. Ukraine apologized and said it was possibly another case of Russian electronic jamming diverting Ukrainian drones from their intended targets during an operation against military targets in Russia. Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk said Poland would work closely with Lithuania and expected full cooperation from Ukrainian authorities, adding that no foreign country may conduct military operations on or over Polish territory without Warsaw's explicit consent. Facts remain unsettled: Lithuanian findings suggest the drone passed through Polish airspace, but Polish military radar initially showed no corresponding border crossing, and Poland has not published a final military finding. The Polish and Lithuanian defence ministries have set up a joint group to investigate. A Polish outlet citing unofficial findings claimed the drone took off from Lithuania, which the Polish Defence Ministry denied and Lithuanian authorities rejected.

title.zh: 欧盟峰会：预算无协议，乌克兰出现700亿欧元资金缺口
title.en: EU summit ends without budget deal and with a new €70 billion gap for Ukraine

summary.zh: 欧盟领导人10月15至16日在布鲁塞尔举行峰会，议程包括竞争力、能源价格、2028至2034年预算、乌克兰、俄罗斯的混合攻击、移民和中东。欧洲理事会官方表示，会议就竞争力、乌克兰、摩尔多瓦、多年期财政框架、中东、欧洲防务与安全、移民、扩大等议题通过了结论。但欧洲新闻台的报道描绘的是另一幅图景：领导人在没有预算协议的情况下结束会议，乌克兰出现新的700亿欧元资金缺口，能源和移民问题上公开交锋；丹麦、意大利和波兰推动在移民问题上采用更强硬措辞。法国总统马克龙说，27个成员国在移民问题上的“意识形态分歧”让欧盟“效率低下”。CGTN报道，首日会议在分歧中结束，原定新闻发布会被取消。目前没有结果显示预算或乌克兰资金问题是否已解决。
summary.en: EU leaders met in Brussels on October 15 and 16 with an agenda covering competitiveness, energy prices, the 2028 to 2034 budget, Ukraine, Russian hybrid attacks, migration and the Middle East. The European Council's official outcome says leaders adopted conclusions on competitiveness, Ukraine, Moldova, the multiannual financial framework, the Middle East, European defence and security, migration and enlargement. Euronews painted a different picture: leaders finished with no deal on the budget, a new €70 billion funding gap for Ukraine and open clashes over energy and migration, with Denmark, Italy and Poland pushing for stronger language on migration. French President Emmanuel Macron said ideological divisions among the 27 member states over migration were making the union ineffective. CGTN reported that the first day ended amid differences in views and the cancellation of a scheduled press conference. The results do not say whether the budget dispute or the Ukraine funding gap has been resolved.

title.zh: 默茨举办投资峰会：称投资者意向达2300亿欧元
title.en: Merz hosts investor summit, says about €230 billion in investment signalled

summary.zh: 德国总理默茨主办了政府首次投资者大会，试图重振欧洲最大经济体的增长。10月20日，他表示在为期两天的“投资德国”峰会后，投资者已表示有意投入约2300亿欧元。英伟达在峰会上点名了四家德国初创企业作为投资对象，包括Agile Robots、Avelios Medical、Mirelo和Reflex Aerospace，这是其近100亿美元欧洲人工智能生态承诺的一部分；默茨也敦促中小企业拥抱人工智能。同时，默茨警告说，公众低估了俄罗斯带来的威胁，普京的目标不仅是击败乌克兰，还包括破坏欧洲的民主。国内政治上他处境艰难：一项公共广播机构调查显示，只有约十分之一的德国人对他的表现满意，为1997年以来所有总理中最低。
summary.en: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz hosted the government's first investor conference in Berlin, a fresh push to revive growth in Europe's biggest economy. On October 20 he said investors had signalled plans worth about €230 billion after the two-day Invest in Germany Summit. At the summit, Nvidia named four German startups as investment targets, Agile Robots, Avelios Medical, Mirelo and Reflex Aerospace, as part of a commitment of nearly $10 billion for Europe's AI ecosystem, and Merz urged small and mid-sized firms to embrace AI. Merz also warned that the public underestimates the threat from Russia and that Putin aims to undermine democracy in Europe as well as defeat Ukraine. At home he is in a weak position: a public broadcaster survey found only about one in ten Germans were satisfied with his performance, the lowest for any chancellor since 1997.

title.zh: 俄无人机袭击基辅心脏病研究所手术室
title.en: Russian drone hits operating room at Kyiv cardiology institute

summary.zh: 10月20日，俄罗斯无人机袭击了基辅斯特拉热斯科心脏病研究所，击中六楼的手术室，造成一名患者受伤。乌克兰总理谢尔希·科雷茨基说，没有人死亡，受伤患者已得到所需救治。国家医学科学院确认，患者已被转移到其他科室，医院继续运转。这家研究所此前在2025年9月也曾遭到袭击，当时四楼及三楼、五楼部分受损，一名护士和一名患者死亡。基辅市长维塔利·克利奇科还说，索洛米扬斯基区另一处医疗设施也被无人机击中，屋顶部分被毁。各方对全市伤亡数字说法不一：《基辅独立报》的标题称全市12人受伤，另一版本则写作5人，另有媒体称全市一人死亡。
summary.en: Russian drones struck the Strazhesko Institute of Cardiology in Kyiv on October 20, hitting an operating room on the sixth floor and injuring one patient. Ukrainian Prime Minister Serhii Koretskyi said no one died and the injured patient received the care needed. The National Academy of Medical Sciences confirmed that patients were moved to other departments and that the hospital kept operating. The institute was hit before, in September 2025, when damage to the fourth floor and parts of the third and fifth floors killed a nurse and a patient. Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko said a separate drone hit a medical facility in the Solomianskyi district and partly destroyed its roof. Citywide casualty counts differ: the Kyiv Independent's headline says 12 people were injured across the city, another version of its story says five, and another outlet reported one person killed citywide.

title.zh: 泽连斯基在奥斯陆会见特朗普特使，防空拦截弹成焦点
title.en: Zelensky meets Trump's envoys in Oslo as air-defence interceptors dominate talks

summary.zh: 10月20日，乌克兰总统泽连斯基在奥斯陆会见美国特使史蒂夫·威特科夫，贾里德·库什纳远程参加，会谈涉及和平提议、防空和联合生产，挪威首相称会谈良好且富有建设性。核心争议是防空：泽连斯基说乌克兰的爱国者拦截弹几乎用完，并指责五角大楼扣押欧洲盟友已经购买的导弹。国务卿鲁比奥向泽连斯基承认，已由北约国家付款的爱国者拦截弹可能出现延迟，但把原因归于美国自身库存需要，而非政治决定，他还否认情报共享受到限制，并称特朗普政府的乌克兰政策没有改变。泽连斯基说，他与鲁比奥的通话“有实质内容”，乌克兰又重新收到俄罗斯弹道导弹袭击的预警，他还要求恢复星链和星盾的使用。威特科夫预计周三向俄方官员介绍这些提议。
summary.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky met U.S. envoy Steve Witkoff in Oslo on October 20, with Jared Kushner joining remotely, and the talks covered peace proposals, air defence and joint production. Norway's prime minister called them good and constructive. The main dispute was over air defence. Zelensky said Ukraine has nearly run out of Patriot interceptors and accused the Pentagon of holding up missiles that European allies had already paid for. Secretary of State Marco Rubio acknowledged to him that there could be a delay in sending Patriot interceptors paid for by NATO countries, but attributed it to U.S. stockpile needs rather than a political decision. Rubio also denied that intelligence sharing was restricted and said the Trump administration's Ukraine policy had not changed. Zelensky said his call with Rubio was substantive, that Ukraine was again getting early warnings of Russian ballistic missile attacks, and that he is pressing for Starlink and Starshield access to be restored. Witkoff was expected to present the proposals to Russian officials on Wednesday.

title.zh: 威特科夫与普京会晤，俄方排除“政治让步”
title.en: Witkoff meets Putin as Moscow rules out political concessions

summary.zh: 据CNN报道，美国特使威特科夫10月21日在圣彼得堡与普京会晤，这是两人的第九轮会谈，紧随鲁比奥所称与乌克兰总统泽连斯基在奥斯陆的“积极”会谈。威特科夫宣布，俄罗斯将释放被关押四年多的美国人斯蒂芬·哈伯德。他对普京说，自己带来了关于可能结束乌克兰战争的想法，并敦促恢复俄美乌三方会谈；普京则提出恢复美俄经济联系，以及可能在北京举行三方会晤。俄外长拉夫罗夫说莫斯科会研究这些提议，但强调不会作出“政治让步”。会前，克里姆林宫发言人佩斯科夫说俄方想要和平而不是临时停火，并反驳特朗普所说泽连斯基“不是合适的谈判人选”，称莫斯科希望对方有一名能决策的合法代表。
summary.en: U.S. envoy Steve Witkoff met Vladimir Putin in St. Petersburg on October 21, their ninth round of talks, CNN reported, following what Secretary of State Marco Rubio called positive discussions with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky in Oslo. Witkoff announced that Russia will free American Stephen Hubbard, who has been detained for more than four years. He told Putin he had brought ideas for a possible deal to end the war in Ukraine and urged him to consider resuming trilateral Russia-U.S.-Ukraine talks. Putin raised restoring U.S.-Russia economic ties and a possible three-way meeting in Beijing. Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov said Moscow would study the proposals but that Russia will not make political concessions. Before the meeting, Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said Russia wants peace, not a temporary truce, and pushed back on Trump's remark that Zelensky is not the right person to negotiate, saying Moscow wants a legitimate representative who can make decisions.

title.zh: 意大利与西班牙同意结束因休达移民危机引发的边境检查
title.en: Italy and Spain agree to end border checks sparked by Ceuta migrant crisis

summary.zh: 意大利总理梅洛尼与西班牙首相桑切斯10月16日在布鲁塞尔欧洲理事会峰会期间会谈，同意解除双方的边境限制。争端始于7月31日：罗马以安全为由，对来自西班牙的旅客实施检查，起因是大批移民从摩洛哥涌入休达，西班牙随后对来自意大利的旅客也实施了检查。意大利把检查期限仅延长七天，使之与西班牙的期限同时到期，西班牙目前的延期到10月22日，意大利的通知则持续到10月23日。两国政府已指示内政部长在未来一周研究替代安排，细节仍在敲定中。一些报道称，双方在移民问题本身上仍有分歧，而且两国都尚未正式撤回各自的措施。
summary.en: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni and Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez agreed on October 16, in talks on the sidelines of the European Council summit in Brussels, to lift the restrictions on each other's borders. The dispute began on July 31, when Rome introduced checks on travellers arriving from Spain, citing security concerns after the mass arrival of migrants in Ceuta from neighbouring Morocco, and Spain responded with checks on travellers arriving from Italy. Italy extended its checks by only seven days so that they expire together with Spain's: Spain's current extension runs to October 22, and Italy's notification runs through October 23. The two governments have instructed their interior ministers to consider alternative arrangements over the coming week, and the details are still being worked out. Some reports say the sides still disagree on migration itself, and neither has formally withdrawn its measures.

title.zh: 亚洲
title.en: Asia

title.zh: 高市早苗执政满一年，内阁支持率跌破五成
title.en: One year in, Takaichi's cabinet support slips below 50 per cent in Kyodo poll

summary.zh: 10月20日是日本首相高市早苗就任一周年。共同社10月17至18日的民调显示，内阁支持率为49.1%，是该社首次出现低于50%的读数，也是她上任以来的最低水平；ANN民调则下降11.2点至47.1%，《读卖新闻》调查则显示支持率为57%。下滑发生在农林水产大臣矢那和夫辞职之后，他承认声称自己削减了未支持他的市町村长所在地的道路经费，但否认干预实际预算分配。时事通信社报道说，高市面临控制国债发行、为重点政策筹措财源的短期压力，她的财政做法已使日元走弱、债券收益率上升。她还向靖国神社的秋季例大祭送去供品，但据共同社报道预计不会亲自参拜。孟加拉国总理塔里克·拉赫曼将于10月27日在东京与她举行双边会谈。
summary.en: October 20 marked one year since Sanae Takaichi became Japan's prime minister. A Kyodo poll conducted October 17 to 18 put her cabinet's support at 49.1 per cent, the first Kyodo reading below 50 per cent and the lowest since she took office. An ANN poll showed a drop of 11.2 points to 47.1 per cent, while a Yomiuri Shimbun poll had approval at 57 per cent. The slide followed the resignation of farm minister Kazuo Yana, who acknowledged claiming he cut road funding for municipalities whose leaders had not backed him, though he denies intervening in actual budget allocations. Jiji Press reports Takaichi faces near-term pressure to control debt issuance and find funding for key measures after her fiscal approach weakened the yen and pushed bond yields higher. She sent an offering to the Yasukuni Shrine's autumn festival but, according to Kyodo, is not expected to visit in person. Bangladesh's Prime Minister Tarique Rahman is due to hold talks with her in Tokyo on October 27.

title.zh: 韩国因朝鲜战俘披露风波撤回一半驻乌克兰使馆人员
title.en: South Korea pulls half of embassy staff from Ukraine over North Korean POW row

summary.zh: 韩国10月20日宣布，将撤回约一半驻乌克兰大使馆工作人员，使围绕朝鲜战俘遣返信息披露的争端进一步升级。争端源于泽连斯基在联合国大会上披露了相关转移安排；首尔称该安排本应保密，乌克兰方面则表示“没有保密协议”。韩国10月8日召回了大使朴基昌，他10月10日返回首尔，原因是基辅拒绝承认保密约定，也不肯公开道歉。外交部称乌方没有采取建设性步骤，并指出全国范围内持续的空袭威胁使人员安全难以保障。代办尹志完将留下来维持最低限度的政治和外交功能，领事人员也留下保护韩国公民。《日本时报》、《韩国时报》、彭博社和首尔经济日报等均报道了此事。
summary.en: South Korea announced on October 20 that it will withdraw about half of its embassy staff from Ukraine, escalating a dispute over the disclosure of North Korean prisoner-of-war repatriation. The row began when Zelensky disclosed the transfer at the UN General Assembly. Seoul says the arrangement was meant to stay confidential, while Ukrainian sources claim there was no agreement to keep it confidential. Seoul recalled Ambassador Park Ki-chang on October 8, and he returned to Seoul on October 10 after Kyiv refused to acknowledge a confidentiality agreement or issue a public apology. The Foreign Ministry cited Kyiv's lack of constructive steps and pointed to the persistent threat of air strikes across the country, which makes ensuring personnel safety difficult. Charge d'affaires Yoon Ji-wan will remain to maintain minimal political and diplomatic functions, and consular staff will also stay to protect Korean nationals. The Japan Times, Korea Times, Bloomberg and Seoul Economic Daily all reported the move.

title.zh: 金与正警告朝韩边境局势“严峻”，称将增派战术武器
title.en: Kim Yo Jong warns of 'grave situation' on border, weighs more tactical weapons

summary.zh: 朝鲜领导人金正恩的妹妹金与正10月19日表示，南部边境局势不稳，平壤正在考虑沿边境增派更多战术打击手段，作为“先发制人和压制性”措施，并提到可能恢复扩音器广播。争端的起因是9月21日边境爆炸造成三名韩国士兵受伤，首尔正式指责是朝鲜埋设的地雷所致，朝方否认。韩国国防部对金与正的言论表示“严重关切”，并称警告射击和广播是“合法的预防措施”。10月21日，朝鲜人民军元帅朴正天和金与正视察了边境防御工事，金与正说新的火力单位已“进入射击阵地”，朝方还要求边境部队在韩军威胁其安全时采取“迅速而果断的行动”。更早的10月6至7日，朝鲜外务省也警告，连一“毫米”的越界都不会容忍。
summary.en: Kim Yo Jong, the sister of North Korean leader Kim Jong Un, said on October 19 that the situation along the southern border is unstable and that Pyongyang is weighing deploying more tactical strike means along it as a preemptive and suppressive measure, and raised the possibility of resuming loudspeaker broadcasts. The dispute stems from September 21 blasts at the border that injured three South Korean soldiers, which Seoul formally blamed on North Korea-planted mines, a charge the North denies. South Korea's Defence Ministry voiced grave concerns about her remarks and called its warning shots and broadcasts legitimate preventive measures. On October 21, Army Marshal Pak Jong Chon and Kim Yo Jong inspected border fortifications, and she said new firepower units had taken their firing positions. Pyongyang also told border troops to take prompt and resolute action if South Korean forces threaten their safety. On October 6 and 7 the North's Foreign Ministry had warned it would not tolerate crossings by even a millimetre.

title.zh: 以色列大选前一周：民调显示双方阵营均未过半
title.en: A week before Israel's election, polls point to deadlock

summary.zh: 以色列将于10月27日举行大选，多项民调显示陷入僵局，亲内塔尼亚胡阵营和反对派阵营都远未达到多数。《以色列时报》援引的Zman Yisrael民调显示，加迪·艾森科特领导的Yashar党获26席，内塔尼亚胡的利库德集团获20席；反内塔尼亚胡阵营54席，亲内塔尼亚胡阵营49席，两者都低于120席议会所需的61席。Walla民调10月20日显示Yashar为23席，利库德为19席，奥弗·温特领导的“以色列人民党”未过门槛。一项分析称，内塔尼亚胡及其宗教和极右盟友的席位不会超过49席，但也提醒右翼选民往往不信任民调机构、不配合调查，因此民调可能低估了他的实力。Maariv民调还显示，若选举无明确结果，多数以色列人更希望组成联合政府而非再次大选。各方席位数只是快照，彼此有出入。
summary.en: Israel votes on October 27, and polls point to a stalemate, with neither the pro-Netanyahu camp nor the opposition near a majority. In a Zman Yisrael poll cited by the Times of Israel, Gadi Eisenkot's Yashar party wins 26 seats to 20 for Benjamin Netanyahu's Likud, and the anti-Netanyahu bloc stands at 54 seats against 49 for the pro-Netanyahu bloc, both short of the 61 needed in the 120-seat Knesset. A Walla poll on October 20 has Yashar at 23 and Likud at 19, with Ofer Winter's People of Israel party failing to pass the threshold. One analysis says Netanyahu and his religious and far-right allies would capture no more than 49 seats, but cautions that right-wing voters tend to distrust pollsters and may be underestimated. A Maariv poll found most Israelis would prefer a unity government to another election if the vote produces no clear result. Seat counts differ between polls and are only snapshots.

title.zh: 美舰靠近仙宾礁，中菲各执一词
title.en: China says US warship intruded near Sabina Shoal; Manila rejects claim

summary.zh: 中国人民解放军南部战区海军发言人殷罡称，美国海军“查尔斯顿”号未经批准“非法闯入”仙宾礁附近海域，中方已对其进行跟踪监视。菲律宾武装部队驳斥这一说法，称“没有任何一个国家有权要求在国际水域合法通行前获得许可”。美国海军尚未公开评论这次航行，也没有确认是否属于航行自由行动。争端发生在南海紧张局势持续之际：2025年8月，两艘中国船只在追逐菲律宾船只时在黄岩岛附近相撞，美国曾派出两艘军舰前往，中方指责美方侵犯主权，美国第七舰队则称其“主张航行权利和自由”。此外，菲律宾方面与中国海警此前也互相指责对方撞船，国务卿鲁比奥曾称中方行动是“又一次胁迫性举动”。目前有关“查尔斯顿”号的报道仍只是初步消息。
summary.en: Yin Gang, spokesman for the Southern Theatre Command Navy of China's People's Liberation Army, said the USS Charleston illegally intruded into waters around Sabina Shoal without approval and that the PLA Navy tracked the ship. The Armed Forces of the Philippines rejected the claim, saying no single nation has the authority to require prior permission for lawful transit through international waters. The U.S. Navy has not publicly commented on the transit or confirmed whether it was a freedom of navigation operation. The dispute comes amid continuing tension in the South China Sea. In August 2025, two Chinese ships collided while chasing a Philippine vessel near Scarborough Shoal, the U.S. sent two warships, China accused Washington of violating its sovereignty, and the U.S. 7th Fleet said it asserted navigational rights and freedoms. Separately, Manila and the Chinese coast guard have traded accusations of ramming, and Secretary of State Marco Rubio called one Chinese action yet another coercive move. Reports on the Charleston remain initial.

title.zh: 台湾指控北京借制裁干预地方选举
title.en: Taiwan accuses Beijing of election interference over sanctions on candidate's family firm

summary.zh: 台湾陆委会10月14日指控，北京利用有针对性的媒体叙事给政治阵营和候选人贴标签并施加经济压力，企图胁迫台湾社会、干预选举。导火线是中国国台办禁止与台北市长参选人沈伯洋父亲沈图成相关的公司VWAY与大陆实体做生意，称他在2025年6月另一家企业被制裁后仍持续与大陆企业交易。陆委会说，这类制裁遵循熟悉的程序：先有香港媒体报道，再由国台办正式宣布。沈伯洋则称这些指控是自2024年起不断重复的旧说法。陆委会副主委沈有忠10月18日警告，下个月的地方选举可能面临中国干预；另有一家军方背景的大陆媒体威胁了出席沈伯洋竞选活动的台湾电视主持人。陆委会表示，随着选举临近，干预很可能加剧。
summary.en: Taiwan's Mainland Affairs Council said on October 14 that Beijing was using targeted media narratives to label political camps and candidates and apply economic pressure, an attempt to coerce Taiwanese society and interfere in its elections. The trigger was China's Taiwan Affairs Office barring VWAY Co., a firm linked to Shen Tu-cheng, the father of Taipei mayoral candidate Puma Shen, from doing business with Chinese entities, saying he kept trading with Chinese firms despite a June 2025 sanction on another of his businesses. The council said the sanctions followed a familiar sequence of Hong Kong media reports followed by an official Taiwan Affairs Office announcement. Shen rejected the allegations as old claims repeated since 2024. Deputy Minister Shen Yu-chung warned on October 18 of possible Chinese interference in next month's local elections, and a Chinese military-affiliated outlet threatened a Taiwanese TV host who attended a Shen campaign event. The council says interference is likely to intensify as the elections approach.

title.zh: 澳洲独立议员海恩斯遭车辆撞击，情况危急
title.en: Australian MP Helen Haines in critical condition after being struck by vehicle

summary.zh: 澳大利亚独立联邦议员海伦·海恩斯在位于旺加拉塔的选区办公室外被车辆撞击，目前情况危急。据澳大利亚广播公司报道，事发于10月19日下午，总理阿尔巴尼斯称这起袭击是蓄意的，一名嫌疑人已被拘留。警方已就此事对布伦丹·纽金特提出三项指控。海恩斯代表维多利亚州的因迪选区。ABC的头条只给出了上述概要，更多细节如动机、指控的具体罪名和海恩斯伤情的最新进展尚未在搜索结果中得到说明。目前还不清楚警方是否还会提出新的指控，也没有关于政界对这起事件的更多反应的报道。该报道属于仍在发展的新闻，伤势和案情可能会变化。
summary.en: Independent federal MP Helen Haines was struck by a vehicle outside her electorate office in Wangaratta, and she remains in critical condition, the Australian Broadcasting Corporation reported. It happened on the afternoon of October 19. Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said the attack was deliberate and that a suspect is in custody. Police have laid three charges against Brendan Nugent over the incident. Haines represents the Victorian seat of Indi. The ABC reporting available gives only this outline, and further details such as a motive, the specific offences charged and the latest on her condition were not shown in the results. It is also not clear whether police will lay further charges, and there was no coverage of wider political reaction. This is a developing story, and her condition and the case could change.

title.zh: 新加坡空气质量转差，预计10月21日达“不健康”水平
title.en: Singapore haze: air quality turns unhealthy, forecast of 110 to 180 PSI for October 21

summary.zh: 新加坡国家环境局预测，10月21日空气质量将处于“不健康”水平，污染物标准指数（PSI）为110至180。该局称，加里曼丹的火灾烟雾可能随着风向转为东南偏东而飘向新加坡。据转载《海峡时报》报道的雅虎新闻，10月20日新加坡空气质量下降，五个区域中有四个出现不健康的污染水平。同日，新加坡总理黄循财正在对卡塔尔和阿联酋进行访问，访问卡塔尔的时间为10月18日至20日，随后将于10月20日至22日访问阿联酋。搜索结果没有显示当日马来西亚、印度尼西亚或泰国的相关消息，也没有说明此次烟霾是否会影响学校或航班安排，更多官方指引请以环境局最新通告为准。
summary.en: Singapore's National Environment Agency forecasts that air quality on October 21 will be in the unhealthy range, with a Pollutant Standards Index of 110 to 180. The agency said smoke from fires in Kalimantan may drift toward Singapore as winds shift to the east-southeast. According to Yahoo News carrying Straits Times reports, air quality dipped on October 20, with four out of five regions facing unhealthy levels of pollution. On the same day, Prime Minister Lawrence Wong was on a trip to the Gulf, visiting Qatar from October 18 to 20 and the United Arab Emirates from October 20 to 22, according to his office. The results did not show related news from Malaysia, Indonesia or Thailand for the day, and did not say whether the haze would affect schools or flights. For official guidance, readers should check the agency's latest advisory.

title.zh: 巴基斯坦：与阿富汗的谈判不能“无条件”
title.en: Pakistan says talks with Afghanistan cannot be unconditional

summary.zh: 巴基斯坦外交部10月17日表示，与阿富汗的谈判不能无条件进行，并要求建立一个可核查的机制，阻止来自阿富汗领土的袭击，同时还警告印度不要再有任何侵略行为。据报道，两国双边贸易已从2024至2025财年的13亿美元降至2025至2026财年的3.58亿美元，数据来自巴方。《黎明报》10月20日的头条提到，赞加利检查站的争议一度打乱了托尔卡姆口岸的运作，约两小时后遣返阿富汗人的工作恢复。同日，巴基斯坦和卡塔尔同意加强内部安全合作。巴基斯坦与英格兰的三国一日赛系列中，巴基斯坦在拉瓦尔品第以87分获胜，已两战全胜。更多关于谈判进展的细节在搜索结果中并不明确。
summary.en: Pakistan's Foreign Office said on October 17 that talks with Afghanistan cannot be unconditional and that it wants a verifiable mechanism to stop attacks coming from Afghan soil, while also warning India against any future aggression. Pakistani trade data show bilateral trade fell from $1.3 billion in 2024-25 to $358 million in 2025-26. Dawn's October 20 headlines included a dispute over the Zangali checkpost that disrupted operations at the Torkham crossing, with the repatriation of Afghans resuming after about two hours. On the same day, Pakistan and Qatar agreed to strengthen internal security cooperation. In sport, Pakistan won by 87 runs against England in the second match of their ODI tri-series in Rawalpindi on October 20 and has won both of its matches so far. The results did not give more detail on the state of the talks.

title.zh: 鲁比奥确认美日印澳“四方机制”领导人峰会下月在马尼拉举行
title.en: Rubio confirms first Quad leaders' summit in two years, in Manila next month

summary.zh: 美国国务卿鲁比奥表示，美国、日本、印度和澳大利亚的领导人将在东盟系列会议期间于马尼拉举行“四方机制”峰会，这将是该组织两年多来首次领导人峰会，上一次是在2024年9月。具体日期尚未确定：有报道称东盟相关会议在11月16日至18日，另一份报道称为11月15日至17日。鲁比奥说，领导人将能够宣布具体行动，而不只是一次社交性的聚会，不过目前并未公开确认任何具体成果。据报道，莫迪、特朗普以及日本和澳大利亚领导人预计出席，但时间和形式尚未最终确定。南华早报称，特朗普预计在峰会几天后于深圳的亚太经合组织峰会上与习近平会晤。《日本时报》说，这一峰会希望为该机制注入新的活力。
summary.en: Secretary of State Marco Rubio said the leaders of the United States, Japan, India and Australia will hold a Quad summit in Manila on the sidelines of the ASEAN meetings, the first Quad leaders' summit in more than two years, since September 2024. The exact date is not set: one report puts the ASEAN-related meetings at November 16 to 18, another at November 15 to 17. Rubio said the leaders will be able to announce concrete actions rather than hold a purely social gathering, though no specific deliverables have been publicly confirmed. One report says Modi, Trump and the leaders of Japan and Australia are expected to attend, with timing and format not final. The South China Morning Post said Trump is expected to meet Xi Jinping a few days later at the APEC summit in Shenzhen. The Japan Times said the summit hopes to breathe fresh life into the grouping.

title.zh: 中国
title.en: China

title.zh: 香港选委会界别选举提名截止，31个界别超额报名
title.en: Hong Kong Election Committee nominations close with 31 of 36 subsectors oversubscribed

summary.zh: 香港2026年选举委员会界别分组普通选举的提名期于10月20日结束。当局共收到1115份候选人提名表格，另有40份来自指定团体，新华社报道的总数为1155份。36个界别分组中有31个获得的提名数超过法定议席，其余5个刚好满额；第一界别的全部18个界别分组均超额。其中“社会福利界”有25人竞逐15席，“医学及卫生服务界”有23人竞逐15席。候选人资格审查委员会将在提名期结束后14日内在宪报刊登有效提名候选人名单，若有效提名人数超过议席，将于投票日举行投票，投票日定于11月22日。今年提名的一个特点是不少前高级官员重新参选。中国日报亚洲版、《南华早报》等亦报道了此事。
summary.en: Nominations for Hong Kong's 2026 Election Committee subsector ordinary elections closed on October 20. Officials received 1,115 candidate nomination forms, plus 40 from designated bodies, which Xinhua reports as a total of 1,155. Thirty-one of the 36 subsectors drew nominations exceeding their seats, while the other five reached full capacity, and all 18 subsectors in the first sector, covering industrial, commercial and financial interests, were oversubscribed. Social Welfare recorded 25 nominees for 15 seats, followed by Medical and Health Services with 23 candidates for 15 seats. The Candidate Eligibility Review Committee will, within 14 days after nominations close, publish a notice of validly nominated candidates in the gazette, and where candidates outnumber seats a poll will be held on voting day, set for November 22. A notable feature of this year's nominations is the number of former senior officials returning to politics.

title.zh: 中国国家数据集团在雄安成立，丁薛祥出席揭牌
title.en: China launches state-owned National Data Group in Xiong'an

summary.zh: 中国国家数据集团10月20日在河北雄安新区成立，国务院副总理丁薛祥出席。据新华社报道，丁薛祥认为这有助于抓住人工智能发展的先机、培育新的竞争优势。这是一家中央管理的国有企业，职责是建设、连接和运营全国规模的数据资产。央视报道称，集团董事长兼党组书记为简勤，总经理为陈荣辉，不过领导层名单只出自财新一家媒体，需以官方发布为准。该集团由大型国有电信运营商和电力企业支持，全资国有。国家数据局2023年成立，负责政策设计，而国家数据集团则侧重于市场运作和数据资源的落地。国家数据专家咨询委员会成员张向宏说，目标是促进跨行业、跨区域共享、打破“数据孤岛”，加快形成全国统一的数据市场。
summary.en: The China National Data Group was launched in Xiong'an, Hebei, on October 20, with Vice Premier Ding Xuexiang attending the inauguration. According to Xinhua, Ding framed the group as a way to seize openings in AI development and cultivate fresh competitive advantages. It is a centrally administered, wholly state-owned enterprise tasked with building, connecting and operating data assets at a national scale. CCTV reported that Jian Qin was appointed chairman and Party chief and Chen Ronghui general manager, though the leadership names come from a single outlet, Caixin, and should be verified against an official release. The group is backed by major state-owned telecom operators and power utilities. The National Data Administration, formed in 2023, handles policy design, while the new group will focus on market operations and putting data resources to use. Zhang Xianghong, a member of the national data expert advisory committee, said the aim is to boost sharing across sectors and regions, clear data silos and speed the creation of a unified national data market.

title.zh: 特朗普称愿赴华会晤普京和习近平，主题是无核化
title.en: Trump says he is ready to meet Putin and Xi in China, with denuclearization on the agenda

summary.zh: 特朗普表示，他愿意下月赴华与普京和习近平会晤，主要议题是核武器与无核化，而不是乌克兰。他说，“我们会谈核武器和无核化”，并强调如果乌克兰问题被提起，他会“尽一切努力结束这场战争”。这场会晤可能在亚太经合组织峰会期间举行，该峰会11月18至19日在深圳举行，但此事尚未确认。克里姆林宫发言人佩斯科夫说，没有任何人就会晤或其议程提出过实质性建议，中国外交部则表示没有相关信息。障碍也很明显：乌克兰希望在任何会谈中拥有一席之地；中国长期拒绝加入美俄中三边军控谈判，理由是自身核武库规模较小。一位分析人士说，在没有明确议程的情况下，三方在深圳会面的可能性相当渺茫。
summary.en: President Donald Trump said he is willing to meet Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping in China next month, with nuclear weapons and denuclearization as the main topic rather than Ukraine. We would have it to talk about nuclear weapons and denuclearization, he said, adding that he would do whatever he can to end the war if Ukraine came up. The meeting could take place on the sidelines of the APEC summit in Shenzhen on November 18 and 19, but nothing is confirmed. Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said no substantive proposals about the meeting or its agenda had been put forward by anyone, and China's foreign ministry said it had no information. The obstacles are clear: Ukraine wants a role in any talks, and China has long refused to join trilateral arms-control talks with the United States and Russia, arguing its nuclear arsenal is smaller. One analyst said that without a clearly agreed agenda, a trilateral meeting in Shenzhen looks rather remote.

title.zh: 美国禁止联邦文职机构使用DeepSeek，中方警告将反制
title.en: US bans DeepSeek from federal civilian systems; China warns of retaliation

summary.zh: 美国国土安全部发布命令，要求联邦文职机构从其IT系统中清除DeepSeek技术，并禁止采购任何使用DeepSeek技术开发的第三方产品和服务。该命令7月签发，10月19日周一公布，不涉及私人个人或企业。国土安全部称相关模型存在“多重威胁载体”，并担心数据可能转移到中国，也可能含有恶意软件或安全漏洞；联邦机构可在60天内以书面理由申请豁免。中国外交部发言人毛宁说，中方将“坚决维护中国企业的合法权益”，并称中方一贯反对泛化国家安全概念；商务部表示“强烈不满、坚决反对”，并警告将采取反制措施。《韩国时报》报道，中方称美方此举无视中美两国元首达成的共识。有报道称，AI已成为美中博弈的关键领域。目前尚未看到北京采取具体反制步骤。
summary.en: The U.S. Department of Homeland Security has issued an order requiring civilian federal agencies to strip DeepSeek technology from their IT systems and barring them from buying third-party products and services developed using it. The order, issued in July and made public on Monday, October 19, does not cover private individuals or businesses. DHS said the models pose multiple threat vectors and raised concerns that sensitive data could be transferred to China or that the models could contain malware or security vulnerabilities; agencies can request exceptions with a written justification within 60 days. Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Mao Ning said Beijing will resolutely safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of Chinese companies and opposes the overstretching of the concept of national security. The Commerce Ministry voiced strong dissatisfaction and firm opposition and warned of retaliatory measures. The Korea Times reported that China says the ban disregards the consensus between the two leaders. Reports describe AI as a key battleground between Washington and Beijing, and no concrete Chinese countermeasure has been seen yet.

title.zh: 中国第三季度GDP同比增长4.5%，好于预期
title.en: China's economy grows 4.5% in the third quarter, beating forecasts

summary.zh: 国家统计局10月19日公布，中国第三季度国内生产总值同比增长4.5%，高于第二季度的4.3%，也高于路透社和彭博社4.4%的预期；环比增长1.2%。前三季度增长4.6%，经济总量约107.11万亿元。全年增长目标为4.5%至5%，第三季度处于区间下沿，分析人士认为，前三季度增速位于目标区间内，当局在第四季度推出大规模刺激的压力较小。其他数据显示，9月规模以上工业增加值同比增长5.5%，社会消费品零售总额仅增长1.1%，而前九个月固定资产投资下降7.2%，投资额为33.41万亿元。零售疲弱和投资下滑，意味着内需仍是主要隐忧。
summary.en: China's gross domestic product grew 4.5 per cent year on year in the third quarter, the National Bureau of Statistics said on October 19, up from 4.3 per cent in the second quarter and above the 4.4 per cent consensus compiled by Reuters and Bloomberg. Output rose 1.2 per cent from the previous quarter. For the first three quarters, growth was 4.6 per cent, with output of about 107.11 trillion yuan. The 2026 target is 4.5 to 5 per cent, so the third quarter sits at the bottom edge of that range, and analysts said that with the nine-month pace inside the range, authorities face less pressure to roll out aggressive stimulus in the fourth quarter. Other data showed September industrial output rose 5.5 per cent while retail sales rose just 1.1 per cent, and fixed-asset investment fell 7.2 per cent in the first nine months to 33.41 trillion yuan. Weak retail sales and falling investment leave domestic demand as a main concern.

title.zh: 中国9月出口激增36.3%，贸易顺差逼近万亿美元
title.en: China's September exports surge 36.3% as pressure grows to rebalance trade

summary.zh: 中国海关数据显示，9月出口按美元计同比增长36.3%，远超经济学家约25.5%的预期，也是自2021年初以来的最快增速；进口增长31.0%。9月贸易顺差为1335.3亿美元，前九个月累计顺差约9380亿美元，外界预计全年可能超过去年创纪录的1.2万亿美元。分析人士指出，半导体和汽车等高科技产品推动出口，服装和鞋类也出现反弹；对美出口增长39.6%，达479亿美元。这一增长正值欧盟等贸易伙伴要求中国“再平衡”贸易之际，欧盟已就限制中国混合动力汽车出口达成协议，相关贸易措施预计12月出台，出口商可能抢在期限前加大出货。尽管数据亮眼，上证综指当天下跌0.88%，创业板指下挫3.10%。
summary.en: China's exports rose 36.3 per cent year on year in dollar terms in September, customs data showed, far above the roughly 25.5 per cent economists expected and the fastest since early 2021, while imports climbed 31.0 per cent. The September trade surplus was $133.53 billion, and the January-to-September surplus reached about $938 billion, with expectations that the full year could surpass last year's record of $1.2 trillion. Analysts point to high-tech goods such as semiconductors and autos driving shipments, with apparel and footwear also rebounding, and exports to the United States jumped 39.6 per cent to $47.9 billion. The surge comes as the European Union and other trading partners press China to rebalance trade. A separate EU deal to cap Chinese hybrid vehicle exports and trade measures expected in December may push exporters to ship ahead of the deadline. Despite the data, mainland stocks fell, with the Shanghai Composite down 0.88 per cent and the ChiNext down 3.10 per cent.

title.zh: 欧盟筹建对华“切断开关”，北京警告勿“幻想”
title.en: EU readies a China 'kill switch' tool as Beijing warns Brussels not to 'fantasise'

summary.zh: 欧盟正在制定一项新的贸易工具，可在特定条件下迅速把中国企业排除出欧盟单一市场，北京对此作出回应。欧盟委员会主席冯德莱恩表示，委员会将根据法德两国的提议建立这一工具，限制市场准入，在某些条件下甚至可以完全关闭欧洲市场。报道称，该提议目前仍是领导人讨论阶段，还没有法律文本，并且没有明确点名中国，称该工具适用于任何国家。中国商务部驳斥了欧盟施压已奏效的说法，称“完全没有根据”，并警告欧盟不要指望靠施压换取让步。《南华早报》报道，中方警告欧盟不要“幻想”。此事发生在欧盟与中国就限制中国混合动力汽车出货量达成协议之后，协议规定自2027年起每年不超过35万辆。
summary.en: The European Union is developing a new trade tool that could quickly exclude Chinese companies from its single market under certain conditions, and Beijing has pushed back. Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said the Commission will build the instrument from a Franco-German proposal to limit market access, which under some conditions could amount to a complete closure of the European market. One outlet notes that at this stage it is a matter for leaders' discussions rather than a proposal with legal text, and the proposal does not explicitly name China, saying the instrument should apply regardless of country. China's Ministry of Commerce rejected the claim that EU pressure had proved effective as entirely groundless and warned the bloc not to expect pressure to win concessions. The South China Morning Post reported that Beijing told Brussels not to fantasise about its trade approach. The dispute comes shortly after a deal to cap Chinese hybrid car shipments to Europe at 350,000 a year from 2027.

title.zh: 王毅结束欧亚四国之行，称中国愿与欧洲加强多边合作
title.en: Wang Yi wraps up four-country Eurasia tour, says China will work with Europe on multilateralism

summary.zh: 中国外长王毅10月14日至20日访问阿塞拜疆、克罗地亚、黑山和保加利亚。他作为习近平特别代表，出席了在巴库举行的亚洲相互协作与信任措施会议峰会，这是他七年来首次正式访问阿塞拜疆。在黑山，据报道，这是中国外长自黑山独立以来的首次访问，恰逢两国建交20周年，会谈涉及基础设施、能源和贸易，包括有欧洲融资支持的巴尔—博利亚雷高速公路。在索菲亚，王毅10月19日与保加利亚外长韦莱斯拉娃·彼得罗娃共同会见记者，说中国将与欧洲在多边主义和自由贸易方面合作。中国外交部称克罗地亚是中国在欧盟的重要伙伴，并以中企承建的佩列沙茨大桥为旗舰项目。分析人士认为此行是北京巩固贸易通道和地缘影响力的一部分，尤其是连接中国与欧洲的中间走廊。
summary.en: Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi toured Azerbaijan, Croatia, Montenegro and Bulgaria from October 14 to 20. He attended the Conference on Interaction and Confidence-Building Measures in Asia summit in Baku as Xi Jinping's special representative, his first official visit to Azerbaijan in seven years. In Montenegro, reports say it was the first visit by a Chinese foreign minister since the country became independent, coinciding with the 20th anniversary of diplomatic ties, and talks covered infrastructure, energy and trade, including the Bar-Boljare motorway backed by European financing. In Sofia on October 19, Wang held a joint press event with Bulgarian Foreign Minister Velislava Petrova and said China would work with Europe on multilateralism and free trade. China's foreign ministry called Croatia an important partner in the EU and pointed to the Chinese-built Pelješac Bridge as a flagship project. Analysts describe the trip as part of Beijing's push to shore up trade corridors and influence, notably the Middle Corridor linking China and Europe.

title.zh: 中方就高市早苗向靖国神社供奉提出严正交涉
title.en: China lodges strong protest over Takaichi's Yasukuni offerings

summary.zh: 中国外交部发言人毛宁在10月19日的例行记者会上，应《环球时报》提问，表示中方坚决反对并强烈谴责日本领导人和政客近期向靖国神社供奉和参拜的行为，并已向日方提出严正交涉。此前，日本首相高市早苗周六以首相名义送去榊枝供品，周一又送去现金供奉，同时数名日本政府官员、自民党高层和议员前往参拜。中国驻日本大使馆称此举是对战后国际秩序的“挑衅”。中方一贯认为，该神社供奉着14名被判有罪的甲级战犯，他们对日本的侵略负有责任。搜索结果中没有看到日方外务省对此作出回应的报道，因此东京的答复尚不得而知。
summary.en: Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Mao Ning, answering a Global Times question at the October 19 regular briefing, said China firmly opposes and strongly condemns the recent offerings and visits by Japanese leaders and politicians to the Yasukuni Shrine, and has lodged serious protests with Japan. The protest followed Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi sending a masakaki branch offering in her name as prime minister on Saturday and a monetary offering on Monday, while several Japanese government officials, senior figures from the ruling Liberal Democratic Party and lawmakers visited the shrine. The Chinese Embassy in Japan called the offering a provocation against the postwar international order. Beijing has long argued that the shrine honours 14 convicted Class-A war criminals responsible for Japan's aggression. The results did not include a Japanese Foreign Ministry response, so Tokyo's reply is not known.

title.zh: 中国央行连续第17个月维持贷款市场报价利率不变
title.en: China's central bank holds loan prime rates for a 17th straight month

summary.zh: 中国人民银行10月20日维持贷款市场报价利率（LPR）不变，一年期为3.00%，五年期以上为3.50%，这是连续第17个月按兵不动。路透社对22家市场机构的调查显示，所有受访者都预期两个利率保持不变。报道指出，中国第三季度经济同比增长4.5%，高于第二季度的4.3%且超出预期，但国内需求和房地产市场仍然疲弱。央行并没有降息，而是在研究调整贷款定价方式，正考虑允许部分财务实力较强的企业使用其他基准利率。这一决定与近期公布的经济数据相互印证：增长保持在目标区间内，使当局在第四季度推出更大规模刺激的压力较小，但零售和投资数据依然偏弱。
summary.en: The People's Bank of China left its loan prime rates unchanged on October 20, with the one-year rate at 3.00 per cent and the five-year rate at 3.50 per cent, the 17th straight month without a change. A Reuters survey of 22 market participants found that all respondents expected both rates to stay put. Reports note that China's economy grew 4.5 per cent year on year in the third quarter, accelerating from 4.3 per cent in the second quarter and beating expectations, but that domestic demand and the property market remain weak. Rather than cutting rates, the central bank is weighing changes to loan pricing and considering allowing some financially strong companies to use alternative benchmarks. The decision sits alongside recent data showing growth within the target range, which eases pressure for larger stimulus in the fourth quarter, even as retail sales and investment stay weak.

title.zh: 体育
title.en: Sports

title.zh: 欧冠：巴黎圣日耳曼4-2击败巴萨，对手赛季首败
title.en: PSG beat Barcelona 4-2 in a Champions League classic

summary.zh: 欧冠联赛阶段第三轮，巴黎圣日耳曼10月20日在王子公园球场4比2击败巴塞罗那，这是巴萨本赛季联赛阶段的首场失利，也是主帅汉斯-迪特·弗里克麾下球队的赛季首败。德西雷·杜埃在第38分钟首开纪录；巴萨的哈维·埃斯帕特扳平，卢卡斯·埃尔南德斯又让巴黎再度领先，拉明·亚马尔把比分追成2比2。随后维蒂尼亚和法维安·鲁伊斯在比赛后段进球锁定胜局。奥斯曼·登贝莱早早伤退，赫维查·克瓦拉茨赫利亚下半场也被人搀扶离场。天空体育称这场比赛双方共有40次射门，是一场经典对决。这场胜利让巴黎与利物浦并列积9分，同居积分榜榜首。
summary.en: Paris Saint-Germain beat Barcelona 4-2 at the Parc des Princes on October 20 in the third round of the Champions League league phase, handing Hansi Flick's side its first defeat of the season. Désiré Doué opened the scoring in the 38th minute. Barcelona's Xavi Espart equalised, Lucas Hernández put PSG back in front and Lamine Yamal levelled again at 2-2. Vitinha and Fabián Ruiz then scored late to settle it. Ousmane Dembélé went off injured early, and Khvicha Kvaratskhelia was also helped off in the second half. Sky Sports noted 40 attempts on goal in total and called the match a classic between two clubs built on attacking firepower. The win lifts PSG level with Liverpool at the top of the standings on nine points from three matches.

title.zh: 欧冠：利物浦先丢两球后4-3逆转比利亚雷亚尔
title.en: Liverpool come from two down to beat Villarreal 4-3 in a seven-goal thriller

summary.zh: 10月20日，利物浦在安菲尔德球场4比3战胜比利亚雷亚尔，上演欧冠七球大战。客队开场不久领先：范戴克在回传门将阿利森时处理失误，格奥尔格斯·米卡乌塔泽在第4分钟打破僵局，塞尔吉·卡多纳随后也进球，把比分拉开到2比0。半场结束前，亚历克西斯·麦卡利斯特和罗纳德·阿劳霍先后进球，将比分扳平。下半场距终场约25分钟时，麦卡利斯特梅开二度，替补上场的弗洛里安·维尔茨又打入第四球。比利亚雷亚尔的塔尼·奥卢塞伊在比赛后段扳回一球，但利物浦守住了胜利。18岁的里奥·恩古莫哈成为焦点，他成为欧冠单场两次助攻的第三年轻球员。利物浦因此与巴黎圣日耳曼并列榜首，各积9分。
summary.en: Liverpool beat Villarreal 4-3 at Anfield on October 20 in a seven-goal Champions League thriller. The visitors struck early: Virgil van Dijk misjudged a headed clearance towards goalkeeper Alisson, and Georges Mikautadze scored in the fourth minute, with Sergi Cardona adding another to make it 2-0 within the first half hour. Alexis Mac Allister and Ronald Araujo then scored before half-time to bring Liverpool level. About 25 minutes from time, Mac Allister struck again to put the hosts ahead, and substitute Florian Wirtz added a fourth. Villarreal's Tani Oluwaseyi scored late to set up a tense finish, but Liverpool held on. Teenager Rio Ngumoha was the main talking point: at 18 years and 52 days old, he became the third-youngest player to provide multiple assists in a Champions League game. The win lifts Liverpool level with Paris Saint-Germain at the top of the standings on nine points from three matches.

title.zh: 英超：马杜埃凯第80分钟破门，阿森纳1-0客胜诺丁汉森林
title.en: Madueke's late goal gives Arsenal a 1-0 win at Nottingham Forest

summary.zh: 英超第七轮，阿森纳10月18日在城市球场1比0客场击败诺丁汉森林。替补登场的诺尼·马杜埃凯在第80分钟打入唯一进球，是一脚折射入网的射门。阿森纳全场控球率高达75%，但创造的预期进球值仅约1.07，天空体育称其唯一一次射正就是制胜球。森林在落后后获得三次不错的机会，却没能把球射正，埃兹里·孔萨还在比赛末段滑铲封堵了利亚姆·德拉普。阿森纳官网描述这一进球是边锋从左路内切后破门，打败了门将马茨·塞尔斯，森林在伤停补时还威胁过扳平。这场胜利让枪手仍落后联赛榜首曼城三分，而森林则跌入降级区。
summary.en: Arsenal won 1-0 at Nottingham Forest's City Ground on October 18 in the seventh round of the Premier League. Substitute Noni Madueke scored the only goal in the 80th minute with a deflected effort. Arsenal had 75 per cent possession over the whole game but created only about 1.07 expected goals, and, according to Sky Sports, their only shot on target was the winner. Forest had three good chances after going behind but could not get an effort on target, and Ezri Konsa made a sliding block to deny Liam Delap late on. Arsenal's own account says the winger cut in from the left before firing past goalkeeper Matz Sels, and Forest threatened an equaliser in injury time. The win keeps the Gunners within three points of league leaders Manchester City, while Forest drop into the relegation zone.

title.zh: 西甲：巴萨九连胜领跑，周日在诺坎普迎战皇马
title.en: LaLiga: Barcelona lead on nine straight wins ahead of Sunday's Clásico

summary.zh: 西甲巴塞罗那取得九连胜，在一场激烈的比赛中以5比2击败少一人的皇家贝蒂斯。据ESPN积分榜，巴萨九轮过后积27分，高居榜首，皇家马德里积21分。两队将于10月25日周日在诺坎普体育场交手，若获胜，巴萨将追平皇马联赛赛季最佳开局的纪录。上一次国家德比是在2026年5月10日，巴萨在诺坎普2比0击败皇马，提前夺得联赛冠军，进球者为马库斯·拉什福德和费兰·托雷斯。这个报道没有给出本轮贝蒂斯一战的进球者和细节，更多信息请以比赛报告为准。国家德比的看点是球队的连胜势头能否延续，以及皇马能否阻止对手拉开更大差距。
summary.en: Barcelona claimed a ninth successive LaLiga win in a fiery 5-2 victory over 10-man Real Betis. According to ESPN's standings, Barcelona top the table on 27 points after nine matches, with Real Madrid on 21. The two meet at Camp Nou on Sunday, October 25, and a win would let Barcelona match Real Madrid's best-ever start to a league season. The last Clásico was on May 10, 2026, when Barcelona beat Real Madrid 2-0 at Camp Nou to clinch the league title, with Marcus Rashford and Ferran Torres scoring. The coverage available does not give the scorers or details of the Betis match, so readers should consult the match report for more. The storyline for the Clásico is whether Barcelona's winning run continues and whether Real Madrid can stop a rival from pulling further clear.

title.zh: NBA开幕夜：活塞逆转凯尔特人，76人在麦迪逊广场花园击败尼克斯
title.en: NBA opening night: Pistons rally past Celtics, 76ers beat Knicks at the Garden

summary.zh: 2026至27赛季NBA在10月20日以三场揭幕战开启。底特律活塞121比113击败波士顿凯尔特人，邓肯·罗宾逊在第四节表现出色，帮助球队在一度落后22分的情况下打出23比0的攻势。费城76人在麦迪逊广场花园以106比100击败纽约尼克斯，破坏了对方的夺冠横幅升起之夜；泰瑞斯·马克西得到28分、5次助攻，勒布朗·詹姆斯代表76人首次出场，拿到14分、7次助攻和9个篮板。雷霆客场击败马刺，谢伊·吉尔吉斯-亚历山大得到全场最高的32分，维克多·文班亚马18投仅1中，但搜索结果中没有该场的最终比分。火箭与独行侠将在周三交手。CBS体育称，新阵容的76人表现令人印象深刻，而杰森·塔图姆和文班亚马则表现挣扎。
summary.en: The 2026-27 NBA season opened on October 20 with a three-game slate. The Detroit Pistons beat the Boston Celtics 121-113, with Duncan Robinson starring in the fourth quarter as Detroit went on a 23-0 run after trailing by 22 points. The Philadelphia 76ers won 106-100 at Madison Square Garden, spoiling New York's championship banner night. Tyrese Maxey led Philadelphia with 28 points and five assists, and LeBron James played his first game for the 76ers, finishing with 14 points, seven assists and nine rebounds. Oklahoma City won at San Antonio, with Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scoring a game-high 32 points while Victor Wembanyama went 1 of 13 from the floor, but the results did not include that game's final score. The Rockets and Mavericks play on Wednesday. CBS Sports said the new-look 76ers impressed, while Jayson Tatum and Wembanyama struggled.

title.zh: NHL：枫叶客场6-2大胜蓝衫军，马修斯出战第700场
title.en: Maple Leafs rout Blue Jackets 6-2 as Matthews hits 700 games

summary.zh: 多伦多枫叶10月20日客场以6比2击败哥伦布蓝衫军。奥斯顿·马修斯在这场比赛中迎来个人第700场NHL比赛，伊斯顿·考恩和杰克·罗斯拉维奇各贡献1球2助攻。枫叶在第二节连进四球，安东尼·斯托拉兹挡下33次射门。前一晚的10月19日，枫叶以3比1击败圣何塞鲨鱼，加文·麦肯纳取得进球，马修斯1球2助攻，谢尔盖·鲍勃罗夫斯基做出30次扑救。再往前，10月17日枫叶以1比4负于纽约岛人，10月15日则在加时赛以4比5不敌水牛城军刀，对手基里尔·马尔琴科上演帽子戏法。枫叶10月10日6比3击败科罗拉多，威廉·奈兰德斩获五分，追平个人最高纪录。球队连续两晚取胜，新赛季战绩起伏。
summary.en: The Toronto Maple Leafs beat the Columbus Blue Jackets 6-2 on the road on October 20. Auston Matthews reached 700 NHL games, and Easton Cowan and Jack Roslovic each had a goal and two assists. Toronto scored four straight goals in the second period, and Anthony Stolarz stopped 33 shots. The night before, on October 19, the Leafs beat San Jose 3-1, with Gavin McKenna scoring, Matthews adding a goal and two assists, and Sergei Bobrovsky making 30 saves. Before that, Toronto lost 4-1 to the New York Islanders on October 17, and 5-4 in overtime to Buffalo on October 15, when the Sabres' Kirill Marchenko scored a hat trick. The Leafs beat Colorado 6-3 on October 10, when William Nylander had five points, tying a career high. Toronto has now won two nights in a row, in a season that has had its ups and downs.

title.zh: NFL：49人队23-17险胜突击者，保持六战全胜
title.en: 49ers hold off Commanders 23-17 to stay unbeaten

summary.zh: NFL第六周，旧金山49人队在李维斯体育场以23比17战胜华盛顿突击者队，保持六战全胜。克里斯蒂安·麦卡弗里两次在1码线冲入达阵，上半场结束时49人队以20比3领先。下半场华盛顿在杰登·丹尼尔斯带领下，从3比23的落后中奋力追分。马利克·穆斯塔法在第四档的传球破坏锁定了胜局，最后一次进攻是对丹尼尔斯造成18码损失的擒杀，擒杀者为基翁·怀特和罗梅洛·海特。49人队的进攻也遭遇打击：老将外接手迈克·埃文斯在半场前跟腱受伤离场。49人队战绩为6胜0负，突击者为1胜4负1平。有报道对比赛日是周日还是周一晚间说法不一。
summary.en: In Week 6 of the NFL season, the San Francisco 49ers beat the Washington Commanders 23-17 at Levi's Stadium to stay unbeaten at 6-0. Christian McCaffrey scored twice, both from one yard out, and San Francisco led 20-3 at half-time. Washington rallied in the second half behind Jayden Daniels, clawing back from a 23-3 deficit. Malik Mustapha's fourth-down pass breakup sealed the win, and the final play was a sack of Daniels for an 18-yard loss by Keion White and Romello Height. The 49ers' offence also took a blow when veteran receiver Mike Evans went down with an Achilles injury just before halftime. San Francisco is 6-0 and the Commanders are 1-4-1. Reports differed on whether the game was played Sunday or on Monday night.

title.zh: MLB世界大赛前瞻：光芒对酿酒人，两队都在追首个总冠军
title.en: World Series preview: Rays and Brewers both chasing a first championship

summary.zh: 2026年世界大赛将由坦帕湾光芒队对阵密尔沃基酿酒人队，首战定于10月23日周五晚8点（东部时间）在密尔沃基举行，由福克斯转播。酿酒人在国联冠军赛横扫道奇队，首次夺得球队史上的国联冠军。光芒在美联冠军赛六场击败克利夫兰守护者，这是他们第三次夺得美联冠军，此前他们在更早一轮横扫了洋基队。据报道，这是自1980年以来，首次有两支都在争取首个总冠军的球队在世界大赛相遇。系列赛时间为10月23日至31日。搜索结果没有提及多伦多蓝鸟，目前尚无世界大赛的比赛结果，首战尚未开打。
summary.en: The 2026 World Series will pit the Tampa Bay Rays against the Milwaukee Brewers, with Game 1 set for Friday, October 23, at 8 p.m. Eastern in Milwaukee, televised on Fox. The Brewers won their first National League pennant in franchise history by sweeping the Dodgers in the NLCS. The Rays won their third American League pennant by beating the Cleveland Guardians in six games, after sweeping the Yankees in an earlier round. According to reports, it is the first World Series since 1980 to match two teams that are seeking their first championship. The series runs from October 23 to 31. The coverage did not mention the Toronto Blue Jays, and no World Series game has been played yet.

title.zh: 泰勒·斯威夫特压轴学院博物馆年度晚会
title.en: Taylor Swift closes the Academy Museum Gala in Los Angeles

summary.zh: 泰勒·斯威夫特在10月17日的第六届学院博物馆年度晚会上压轴演出，并演唱了热门歌曲《Blank Space》。这场洛杉矶晚会表彰了查理兹·塞隆、科尔曼·多明戈和约翰·卡朋特。她的出演此前已经宣布，此外她还出席了2026年MTV音乐录影带大奖，并获得首个“艺术家导演荣誉奖”。晚会上的时尚也引发关注：赞达亚此前在《奥德赛》宣传期间穿着的斯基亚帕雷利胸甲造型，与特雅娜·泰勒在这次晚会上所穿的一件来自同一系列。相关报道只涉及这次演出和时尚话题，没有提到斯威夫特的新项目。
summary.en: Taylor Swift closed the sixth Academy Museum Gala in Los Angeles on October 17, performing her hit Blank Space. The gala honoured Charlize Theron, Colman Domingo and John Carpenter. Her booking had been announced earlier, and it followed her appearance at the 2026 MTV Video Music Awards, where she received the show's first-ever Artist Director Honors. Fashion also drew attention at the event: Zendaya's Schiaparelli breastplate look from The Odyssey press tour came from the same collection as one worn by Teyana Taylor at the gala. The coverage dealt only with the performance and the fashion, and did not mention any new project from Swift.

title.zh: 柴勒梅德与赛琳娜·戈麦斯合作动画科幻片《Not Alone》公布首个官方剧照
title.en: Chalamet and Selena Gomez's animated alien film 'Not Alone' gets first official look

summary.zh: 照明娱乐公司宣布了一部原创动画外星人电影《Not Alone》，将于2027年4月16日上映。这是蒂莫西·柴勒梅德的首次动画配音出演，在片中他为一名火箭机械师配音，赛琳娜·戈麦斯则为一位才华横溢的天文植物学家配音。影片获得了首个官方画面。Screen Rant的报道只提供了片名、档期、主要配音人选和角色设定，剧情细节、导演和其他配音阵容在搜索结果中并未提及。这部影片将是两位明星在动画领域的合作，档期定在春季，而非年底的颁奖季。更多信息可能会在后续宣传中陆续公布。
summary.en: Illumination has announced an original animated alien film, Not Alone, set for release on April 16, 2027. It marks Timothée Chalamet's animation debut, and he voices a rocket mechanic opposite Selena Gomez as a brilliant astro-botanist. The film has received its first official look. Screen Rant's report gives the title, release date, the lead voice cast and the character set-up, while plot details, the director and the rest of the voice cast were not mentioned in the results. The release date puts the film in spring 2027 rather than in the year-end awards season. More information may be released as promotion ramps up.

title.zh: 凯莉·詹纳突然亮相维密大秀，柴勒梅德在台下助阵
title.en: Kylie Jenner makes surprise Victoria's Secret show debut as Chalamet cheers her on

summary.zh: 据Just Jared报道，凯莉·詹纳10月18日在维多利亚的秘密时装秀上突然亮相，身穿价值5000万美元的幻想文胸，她的男友蒂莫西·柴勒梅德在观众席上为她加油。报道的标题是这场亮相的主要内容，其他细节如走秀时间和反应在搜索结果中并未展开。这是一次公开的时装秀亮相，属于公众人物在公开场合的活动。更多关于这次亮相的评论和各方反应，目前没有进一步的报道。
summary.en: Kylie Jenner made a surprise debut at the Victoria's Secret Fashion Show on October 18, wearing a $50 million Fantasy Bra, while her boyfriend Timothée Chalamet cheered her on from the audience, Just Jared reported. The headline carries the main substance of the story, and other details such as the timing of her walk and reactions were not expanded on in the results. It was a public runway appearance by a public figure at a public event. There was no further reporting on comments or reactions to the debut.

title.zh: 梅根·莫罗尼手机锁屏引发与普利西奇的恋情猜测，尚未获证实
title.en: Megan Moroney's phone lock screen fuels Christian Pulisic dating rumours; unconfirmed

summary.zh: 据E! News等报道，乡村歌手梅根·莫罗尼的手机锁屏照片在10月18日维多利亚的秘密派对后被拍下，引发了她与足球运动员克里斯蒂安·普利西奇的约会猜测。E! News已联系莫罗尼和普利西奇的代表置评，但截至报道时尚未收到回复，因此双方至今没有回应，这只是基于一张照片的猜测，并未得到证实。报道没有提供其他可以证明二人关系的证据。本栏目只报道猜测和当事人回应；在当事人表态之前，这一说法应当被视为未经证实的传闻。
summary.en: A photo of country singer Megan Moroney's phone lock screen, taken after a Victoria's Secret afterparty on October 18, set off speculation that she is dating soccer player Christian Pulisic, according to E! News and others. E! News reached out to representatives for Moroney and Pulisic for comment but had not heard back at the time of reporting, so neither has responded, and the speculation rests on a single photo and is unconfirmed. The reports offered no other evidence of a relationship. Until the two comment, the claim should be treated as an unconfirmed rumour.

title.zh: 《我的前半生》剧组十年后重聚，马伊琍与雷佳音合照登上热搜
title.en: 'My Years of Splendor' cast reunite after ten years; Ma Yili and Lei Jiayin photo trends

summary.zh: 据新浪娱乐10月20日18时的热点汇总，电视剧《我的前半生》剧组时隔十年再度聚首，马伊琍与雷佳音同框的合照在社交平台走红，并登上热搜。这张合照在社交平台上悄然刷屏。新浪娱乐的汇总只提供了这一概要，更多关于聚会的地点、参加人员和当事人的评论，搜索结果中并没有展开。这是公众人物之间的一次公开合影，反映的是观众对这部热门剧集的怀念，并不涉及隐私或猜测。
summary.en: According to Sina Entertainment's October 20 hot-topics roundup at 6 p.m., the cast of the TV drama My Years of Splendor, known in Chinese as Wo De Qian Ban Sheng, got together again after ten years, and a group photo of Ma Yili and Lei Jiayin went viral on social media and reached the trending list. The photo quietly flooded feeds. The roundup gives only this outline, and details such as where the reunion took place, who attended and any comments from the stars were not expanded on in the results. It is a public photo among public figures that reflects viewers' nostalgia for a popular series, and it involves no private matters or speculation.
